| | Ships colliding, axes and blades swinging, sailors ducking and dodging, theft and looting... No, it’s not the plot of the next “Pirates of the Caribbean” sequel (but it certainly wouldn’t be out of place). It is China’s latest [provocation](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=70ec786b2a4f4145ba3293845f5799b9&_e=PDlfeZsMsAGIWgmpGnJxprdh7RsuNAq1V7Ye9rrSRlBNlGuXsQbIcVzxrkEPwdDng02hHkJ3Wsvv4mZ7I87Z_LW3-19m_cFo50jtnufN0RksMZj9bX98VT1bJRv0V377eI6EkMFuHwn7b-KV2nHScXCxgEYfq-TdvSXVKPxt4X7muJNloTxy7j_pMHmHDBDkpc1f-EUYFTqyzSEGVr0tQKfY4jpVcy204wMxhM4UyaCAAlJCKsSjj8Mbm4Vfz4Vzc3Pvnt869ENj0Je9WtaleuXD659kXV2jEbn5UmEohG2kzzlGlzLzVDF2UeXJgCUZ) in the South China Sea. Last week, Beijing’s Coast Guard escalated its harassment of naval vessels of the Philippines, hacking at rubber boats, boarding and smashing navigation and communications equipment, stealing property, and more. Make no mistake about it—what the CCP is doing is calculated to control hostilities and manage escalation (on the disputed border with India, they are doing the same, but with sticks and rocks), but replace those axes with guns and what you would have is an act of war. As I’ve warned before, we need to watch what the Chinese Communist Party does and listen to what they say; they are clearly acting recklessly and more like pirates than the responsible government they want the world to believe.

Let me tell you a little bit about myself.... I’m a retired Navy CAPT who spent 25 years fighting for our country in some of the most dangerous battlegrounds in the world. My family and I came to America when I was just four years old after my father was put on a kill list in Communist Vietnam. If it wasn’t for America, I probably wouldn’t be alive today. I owe my life to this country - so I paid her back by attending the Naval Academy after graduating high school and dedicating my career to serving America. I served in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Somalia where I defused IEDs for our SEAL teams and Special Forces. I performed some of the most dangerous dives in the military all around the world. It wasn’t easy, and there were many times where my life flashed before my eyes. But it was worth it, because I was protecting this country so the next generation could have the same opportunities that I did. Now that Democrats are trying to destroy that American Dream, I’m not about to sit by idly. Our fight isn’t just overseas anymore. It’s right here in America, where far-Left liberals in Washington DC are working to erode your freedom and compromise our future. I’m not a career politician. clean_body: If it wasn’t for America, I probably wouldn’t be alive today.| | | Hi, my name is Hung Cao. I just became the OFFICIAL GOP nominee for U.S. Senate in Virginia, THE battleground race that WILL decide the Senate Majority. That’s why I’m reaching out to you fellow American, and Let me tell you a little bit about myself.... I’m a retired Navy CAPT who spent 25 years fighting for our country in some of the most dangerous battlegrounds in the world. My family and I came to America when I was just four years old after my father was put on a kill list in Communist Vietnam. If it wasn’t for America, I probably wouldn’t be alive today. I owe my life to this country - so I paid her back by attending the Naval Academy after graduating high school and dedicating my career to serving America. I served in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Somalia where I defused IEDs for our SEAL teams and Special Forces. I performed some of the most dangerous dives in the military all around the world. It wasn’t easy, and there were many times where my life flashed before my eyes. But it was worth it, because I was protecting this country so the next generation could have the same opportunities that I did. Now that Democrats are trying to destroy that American Dream, I’m not about to sit by idly. Our fight isn’t just overseas anymore. It’s right here in America, where far-Left liberals in Washington DC are working to erode your freedom and compromise our future. I’m not a career politician. I spent my life serving our country, not serving special interests. NOW let me tell you who I’m up against... Remember when Hillary Clinton ran for President? Well, her hand-picked Vice-Presidential candidate, a professional politician and liberal activist named Tim Kaine is MY OPPONENT. Tim Kaine has been nothing but a pawn in the Senate for Hillary Clinton and the special interest groups since they lost to President Trump. But, he’s well-funded by the Clinton allies, and he’s already coming after me with his campaign war chest. We all know running a Senate race is EXPENSIVE, and our funds have been significantly depleted from our primary battle. I'm reaching out to you today to humbly ask for your support in rebuilding our war chest for the General Election which is QUICKLY approaching. ************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************ We have so much riding on this election, and I can’t win this battle without support from patriots like you. Please stand with me today and help me restore the America we know and love. A friend of mine who works at a national environmental organization has often said that her trips exploring different parts of the natural world help fuel her work for the environment by reminding her what she fights for on a daily basis.
While my career in non-profit advocacy focused more on civil rights & civil liberties, my campaigns for public office were motivated largely by a goal to protect the future from an accelerating global ecocide driven by corporate resource extraction and the loss of natural habitat.
More recently, I've been working on a short series of posts examining the global climate crisis. They'll revisit the only solutions that--at this point, after decades of obliviousness and complicity from Wall Street to Washington--could meaningfully address it.
A walk up a mountain this weekend offered a few illustrations that seem like a good place to start the series.
### Damn, my legs are tired
Sunday morning, I got up a little before dawn and went to a trailhead at the base of a mountain not far from where I live. Over the course of the ensuing nine hours, I hiked up and down 3500 feet, covering over 12 miles before returning to the bottom.
It's the most ground I've ever covered in a day, which felt gratifying in itself.
Beyond the opportunity to demonstrate my endurance to myself, however, the hike also offered many beautiful sites, in addition to at least two visible reflections of the mounting global climate catastrophe.
_Help inform your friends!_
[ Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1018597&post_id=145938398&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ1OTM4Mzk4LCJpYXQiOjE3MTkyNzQ1NjEsImV4cCI6MTcyMTg2NjU2MSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTEwMTg1OTciLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.70jsRcKR3QW06kVmqS8VRXGttM8nessyPQyJr6DwExE)
### Show & tell
It's amazing how a landscape can shift, from a meadow replete with wildflowers exhibiting seemingly every hue under the sun, to exposed rock scree, and then back again through each of those cycles.
On my hike this weekend, I saw wildflowers in yellow and white, as well as purple and pink and blue. Below are a handful of my best photos from that morning & afternoon.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5a9887b3-5e05-4588-9519-5bc400f7a1ee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/927fd461-663d-4153-9c62-4acb93606f21?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/970e7d95-c41c-4411-b7aa-b7be43f4c0cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/99b202ef-760a-4c08-8352-9d7b2ff8cd40?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b6b28457-f83b-4473-b126-6087df840b76?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I found myself recalling "The Sound of Music," and half-expected to see a shepherd skipping down the mountain with a flock of sheep.
In addition to wildflowers, I also saw abundant wildlife. Lizards darted over rocks, chipmunks ran between them (and also right up to me), birds filled the air with song as ducks crossed the several ponds and lakes that I passed, dragonflies continually caught my eye (while eluding my camera), and butterflies swarmed in groups bigger than any I've ever seen in the United States.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e7c660ce-7016-4c08-9a81-89973f45b138?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7f287ce8-9e42-457d-a5e9-8a11fa7ebea3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5ef2a69e-eca1-45e1-a3aa-fa4d5fd59023?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/927e43a5-0ddc-42d9-8679-04af85c89843?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
### The trees can talk
One of the most striking aspects of the hike was the impressive biodiversity within the forests. Quaking aspens at the base gave way to jeffrey and ponderosa pine, above which fir trees flourished. I didn't see as many of the cedars that appear in other parts of the local landscape, nor any of the sequoias that draw visitors to other parts of the Sierras.
Among the pines and firs that I witnessed, two particular patterns reflected the disturbing escalation of the climate crisis.
_Chronicles of a Dying Empire is a publication supported by readers, rather than advertisers. To receive new posts,**sign up for a free subscription!** To support my work, please consider becoming a paid subscriber._
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..1BsODMfgeEQFqpXs-xYnbj8MLGWEjiUad7JwVbxzvVo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=145938398)
First, entire sections of the hills and mountains visible from my vantage point were denuded. The bare hills to the East are continuing reflections of wildfires that in recent years have wreaked havoc with the local landscape, prompting dangerous levels of particulate matter in the air and even forcing evacuations when threatening to burn nearby cities--including the one where I now live--to the ground.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b2334580-afba-431e-97d4-f2ecdf153bfe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
These burn scars are prolific, terrible reminders of the [devastation](https://substack.com/redirect/1d70b0a0-423c-4433-93a1-a372d791927a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that wildfires can cause--and [likely will again](https://substack.com/redirect/8f0c2472-0a79-43ad-8611-20682664f869?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at some point.
Even where the forests continue to flourish, many trees revealed sickly branches, with pine needles turning brown. Each of them are effectively dying in slow motion, afflicted by bark beetles that they normally are able to fend off, except when weakened by drought.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8205734e-fb7b-48de-9b00-bfcd14e83005?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Conifers have a [natural defense against bark beetles](https://substack.com/redirect/342bf4d7-64cf-4d35-b5c0-bd954be14601?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the form of sap. When well-hydrated, trees can use sap to counteract beetles and prevent larvae from nesting. When weakened by drought, however, many of these trees become susceptible to native bark beetles. Their trails can be seen in bark, in wood, and in the brown blight spreading across our forests.
Wildfires and drought are both direct consequences of the climate crisis. In many parts of the country, Americans pretend that they can be immune from the effects of this global pattern. Here in the mountains, there is no such pretense.

_Below is a message from Debbie Mucarsel-Powell, who is running for election to the U.S. Senate in Florida._
* * *
Friend, it's Debbie, and I wanted to make sure you saw my opponent's latest stunt. Rick Scott voted against a bill that would protect access to IVF. And the very next day, he released an ad promising to do the exact opposite. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87529796/481469234/-2025838286?refcode=AU_MTH_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240624_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS84OTA0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NDQwYmQwYi04ZTMyLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BPTOhb3GuVRPcz0cIyppV6WyDcmIhs6eOZvJtQNIjOk=) Look, Floridians know that actions speak louder than Rick Scott's empty promises and bold-faced lies. | This is why I am running to be your next Congressman
---
---
| | | | |
---
Today I spent close to eight hours knocking on doors in 95-degree heat. As I continued my journey with one day left before the election, I realized it was all worth it when I spoke with a grandmother named Julie on her front porch today. She informed me that in her sixty years, she has never met any of her elected officials or candidates running for office. Julie informed me that the fact I took fifteen minutes of my day to stand in the heat to hear her concerns was special, and that I made her feel important. As she gave me a hug, I realized that one statement may have been the best thing I have heard in the past six months of this campaign. I realized that my mission of making this campaign about the people is what matters. If I am elected to be your next representative in congress, I will be sure to always make the people of this district the priority. Julie, who is a registered unaffiliated voter, told me that today she was guaranteeing me the four votes in her household. I thanked Julie for her support, and I am now humbly asking for your vote tomorrow. It is important that we turn in our ballots as being able to vote in America is a privilege, and it is important that we exercise our right to vote. I hope that I can have your vote, as well as the vote of your family and friends. If I am so honored to be your next representative in congress, I will make it my goal to make you proud of the work I do for you and our country.
God Bless!
---

| Peter,

Two years ago today, the radical Supreme Court decision overturning _Roe v. Wade**stripped away a constitutional freedom that was law for nearly 50 years.**_ For the first time, women have less rights than their mothers and grandmothers.

When I marched for abortion rights in D.C. as a college student, I never could have imagined we’d be here now – an America in which women are forced to go into sepsis before receiving care and where 12-year-olds are forced to give birth.

The Dobbs decision handed over our healthcare choices to judges and politicians rather than women. Here in Washington, we've seen a more than 50% increase in out-of-state patients – making it harder for Washington state residents to access appointments.

And make no mistake: MAGA extremists are hellbent on passing a national abortion ban. We’ve seen it time and again this year – they’ve tried to add anti-abortion provisions to the agriculture funding bill, the defense bill, and other critical legislation. We also know where they’re going next: they’ve refused to restore federal protections for IVF.

As your Representative for Washington's 6th Congressional District, I’ll fight like hell against a national abortion ban that would override our state protections in Washington state. And together, we will restore federal protections for abortion and all reproductive care.

Hey - my name is Byron Donalds.

As Co-Chair of one of the most important initiatives of the Republican Party, I wanted you to what we're doing right now to lay the groundwork for the biggest GOP landslide in AMERICAN HISTORY!

_**[A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen- so bear with me for a minute:](http://links.gopmembership.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=b35a13376c314c3e8d60ea85b48c17f8&_e=iE8Py5ANSKyCbdGSj0BG9QN5ylzzQVNpkJqXVons2pp5vH-Rgyll-BVx_-ERJlELhEYdbAHBnyz_-araUHe2Utq-j07eTGbCCe8WlDLfejT4sLUgoJ6jmakWfxsnD8nslt7zAKY_MfdLu794MEbDrUaMIqoQRiQIupmCEbI4zhjS2xNJqvpcdD3z3TOC732Hj9u9UmyN0egGMR9KIhHIYwIQMn2T1K0-NaKyfnJP9EeXDIbw6WrU3QwUlLYwRtfJMoBAwupOkT7_YRAl4zDbufG_tlPuCG_yGGRy6kD-ayMypa4VBzngoQ2Nttlqsz5-M7wQPv2tCeVCIAUz-0jW5SgdnliSlFTdPaNoZZxstOrOo55pXeEmv-U4R6Cr_vy5qEUAav7z1Yg_S4mV2za5jg3Zx0Rir4nWfs2wDbkdn_4%3D "A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen – so bear with me for a minute:")**_

-> If the Democrat Legal Machine tries any shenanigans, we'll be there to stop them
-> If Liberals can ballot harvest, we should ballot harvest even better
-> If they're sending poll watchers, we should send an army of our own
-> We're not pandering to minority voters, we're building relationships with them
-> We're expanding GOTV efforts to get young Conservatives to the ballot box
-> We're fighting bad election laws to make it easier to vote but harder to cheat

These are the nuts and bolts of winning campaigns up and down the ballot. And I'm proud to help lead these efforts.

As Conservatives, we have the issues on our side. We are the only commonsense Party. **If we get these campaign operations right, the Democrats are in serious trouble come election day.**

_But I have to be honest with you: building this level of infrastructure is very expensive._ We're running ads in costly swing-state markets, printing campaign literature, filling up gas tanks to knock doors, recruiting volunteers, and scaling up our voter contact programs.

And unlike the Democrats, we don't rely on Liberal billionaires and rich celebrities for funding.

I'm perfectly okay with that. But it means if we want to WIN BIG, the burden falls on all of us to step up. _**[That's why I'm coming to you now - would you be willing to pitch in a few bucks to help kick start these efforts? Whether it's 10 bucks or 100 bucks, I only ask that everyone pitches in SOMETHING.](http://links.gopmembership.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=b35a13376c314c3e8d60ea85b48c17f8&_e=iE8Py5ANSKyCbdGSj0BG9QN5ylzzQVNpkJqXVons2pp5vH-Rgyll-BVx_-ERJlELhEYdbAHBnyz_-araUHe2Utq-j07eTGbCCe8WlDLfejT4sLUgoJ6jmakWfxsnD8nslt7zAKY_MfdLu794MEbDrUaMIqoQRiQIupmCEbI4zhjS2xNJqvpcdD3z3TOC732Hj9u9UmyN0egGMR9KIhHIYwIQMn2T1K0-NaKyfnJP9EeXDIbw6WrU3QwUlLYwRtfJMoBAwupOkT7_YRAl4zDbuc1nzn6-NV-avo3LwvXiNXlftJq-fJtqwjxHVdQY01s0X4x4JldzTTdup5-GO0wonNtO_EZKKpb0hrTIzpJgt3t7FOCXcIi8O-Y1Z2_utMux3cwDrfZV6pJFC-mT8i89i_Dp-rHwBJMBJgeDyL8JFOU%3D "That’s why I’m coming to you now – would you be willing to pitch in a few bucks to help kick start these efforts? Whether it’s 10 bucks or 100 bucks, I only ask that everyone pitches in SOMETHING.")**_

Look,

**I know it 's a lot to ask but I GUARANTEE it'll all be worth it when we expand our Conservative Majority, take back control of the Senate, and win the White House.**

I don't know about you but the thought of unified Republican control fires me up! If that doesn't convince you to want to help, I don't know what will! Are you in?

Hey, Peter, We’re moving further and further away from the fundamental principles of liberty, freedom, and adherence to the Constitution. Our Founding Fathers envisioned a government that would protect these very basic values, not erode them.

True leaders prioritize individual rights over Big Government and freedom over tyranny. These leaders understand that liberty is the cornerstone of our Republic, and they’re committed to protecting it, no matter how unfavorable they are to their political party or the pushback they receive from Washington elites.

**Peter, the truth is simple: we need more leaders who put the Constitution over party loyalty and keep the flame of liberty going, not just today, but for generations to come.**

---
| | [**PROTECT LIBERTY: $20.24**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=92fe58ce29d743be844deb66779ca054&_e=Up-hqVaxdlyZHENMhq4ihrl1D0xoe2_Q4Upv1V6x1o2F56NY2-lnH_UKHr870nVpLq4xJeG3MRT4PBO_cJdHzlNW8s2XonIojvVkv_f1oBQcHyaiQtpEv8skbSc5b84O9fhLHVnacjGMxcBXchWtr6rRnatL6JO-ocH0a0u51FXlEh1kR3SkoHV9dkCycl5WZqMUhtimwXFTiPh0ysNY1FxWGXDgaxLDeiBMalOdkSOCTw06bJSwwq6r3I7mqGzwqUOeZzdnFQK-RT0e-LDOVW4N7ZdrMv8TdXqXvfwGl_Vqtur4FSIEFPVP2pCz4se4Zw4rwEFWk86CopL_11CM7Qw-KJ8jeJieuNvQDWXvvvkarbJ986zo36nXIWfV-tedS93VNammZDtMK1ri-uYbWgnNqL1knHnMt2RNEdsm8TODCv_sdy6Fe98f5h72mtPz)

It’s not enough for politicians to say they believe in freedom and liberty. We need them to stand up, challenge the status quo, and fight for the American people... _because our nation was built on the idea that government should serve the people, not the other way around._

Now more than ever, I’m committed to ensuring liberty-minded folks make their way to Washington, to help me protect and defend the very freedoms that make this country so great. _But I can’t do it alone._

_[**I’m asking you, Peter, to donate $20.24 to help me take back the Senate and keep the flame of liberty going.**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=92fe58ce29d743be844deb66779ca054&_e=Up-hqVaxdlyZHENMhq4ihrl1D0xoe2_Q4Upv1V6x1o2F56NY2-lnH_UKHr870nVpLq4xJeG3MRT4PBO_cJdHzlNW8s2XonIojvVkv_f1oBQcHyaiQtpEv8skbSc5b84O9fhLHVnacjGMxcBXchWtr6rRnatL6JO-ocH0a0u51FXlEh1kR3SkoHV9dkCycl5WZqMUhtimwXFTiPh0ysNY1FxWGXDgaxLDeiBMalOdkSOCTw06bJSwwq6r3I7mqGzwqUOeZzdnFQK-RT0e-LDOVW4N7ZdrMv8TdXqXvfwGl_U_ZHl5WPhIvEBFO7q-iT9B22L1u7xeY9591C7AducsSXfjth0DdgIm5mcJlNNA5ZxLoSUZwWaOtnnb14-NnlUF-WcYvHkj2Z6cCrzE6H92Q_ztru1s2Xka3QtKBPN8g5IIRgPNS2ClFNvYxA8smAZ4)_

Each offers a wide range of products and services, from banking and investment products to financial advisors and financial planning services.

However, there are some important differences, from fees to financial services to research resources, each of which could impact your customer experience. [Learn how these firms compare so you can decide on the fit for you.](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z0s9kb7vd17makjj2orbfkrvneemd5usbdmp53i0_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spi60pb6c5h2bs)

Ready to kickstart your retirement? Working with a financial advisor can be a crucial part of any healthy retirement plan. But with thousands of options available, knowing where to start can seem daunting. That’s why SmartAsset created a [no-cost tool](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z7tn4jukme8rbst88vnt17argm3dj3p3uujnf6cg_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spi60pb6c5h2bs) to help match you with up to three financial advisors serving your area. All advisors on the platform are rigorously screened through a proprietary due diligence process and legally bound to work in your best interest.

While your advisor matches may not necessarily be associated with the above institutions, research suggests people who work with a financial advisor:
* feel more at ease about their finances
* could end up with about 15% more money to spend in retirement.1

It's never too late to plan to work toward a comfortable retirement.

| _Who are you partnered with?_ It’s no secret that Vanguard, Fidelity and Charles Schwab could be considered three of the most popular and well-known brokerage firms. Each offers a wide range of products and services, from banking and investment products to financial advisors and financial planning services.

However, there are some important differences, from fees to financial services to research resources, each of which could impact your customer experience. [Learn how these firms compare so you can decide on the fit for you.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z6s0bmk4450e78kthiqusgr4kcbu67tiok3gmv0g_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spi68ob6c5h2bs)

Ready to kickstart your retirement? Working with a financial advisor can be a crucial part of any healthy retirement plan. But with thousands of options available, knowing where to start can seem daunting. That’s why SmartAsset created a [no-cost tool](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2znsk38kflhslviaom9qqbd79ghvppmejdm9fja2g_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spi68ob6c5h2bs) to help match you with up to three financial advisors serving your area. All advisors on the platform are rigorously screened through a proprietary due diligence process and legally bound to work in your best interest.

While your advisor matches may not necessarily be associated with the above institutions, research suggests people who work with a financial advisor:
* feel more at ease about their finances
* could end up with about 15% more money to spend in retirement.1

It's never too late to plan to work toward a comfortable retirement.

name: CAPT Hung Cao
subject: I’m not your typical Senate nominee
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the NRSC
body:
I served on the front lines disarming explosives with seconds to spare and performed some of the most dangerous deep dives in the military.

My name is CAPT Hung Cao.

I'm a retired Navy Captain who served for 25 years in Special Operations. I served on the front lines disarming explosives with seconds to spare and performed some of the most dangerous deep dives in the military.

[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zdju3727dd62fga2i8sed1u92fegjf3bn80r5emo_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spi6coj4chh2bs)

I was inspired to serve because America gave me everything. **My family escaped Communist Vietnam to the United States after my father was put on the Vietcong 's kill list.**

[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z09q3821vs4v94usls2ar2huc7vetd4m1mo6o0j8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spi6coj4chh2bs)

_If it wasn 't for American freedom, I probably wouldn't be here today._

**I answered the call to duty when I was appointed to the Naval Academy as a young man. Now, I 'm answering the call of duty to Americans once again. _But my new mission is a little different._**

[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zr365ojeju114k5ep1ckhh6g3h2k91h5anl9dpbg_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spi6coj4chh2bs)

**I 'm now the OFFICIAL GOP nominee running for the U.S. Senate in Virginia because our voters believe our country needs true conservative leaders who put service over self. **

**[In the general election, I need an A-team of patriots by my side if we're going to bring my opponent, otherwise known as Hillary Clinton's VP pick, Tim Kaine's decades-long political career to an end. Will you step up and join our team today?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zt4m7b31lnom3tvva8airp0r4aspkehovhurkhr8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spi6coj4chh2bs)**

**[JOIN THE TEAM](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z45vq86qpcplj396tmg1s7rts9hrvk64pnspupsg_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spi6coj4chh2bs)**

**[SEND A NAVY VETERAN TO THE U.S. SENATE](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zs352760qm13ud5iu1so8b078klmsqcom4ijff68_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spi6coj4chh2bs)**

I put my life on the line for our American values and freedom because I know that America is worth defending.

_But today, career politicians like Tim "Hillary" Kaine are eroding the very liberties my fellow troops and I risked the ultimate sacrifice for. _They've lost sight of what matters and are more interested in playing political games than serving the people they're supposed to represent.

_**Now, I 'm stepping up because we need a change.**_

**_I fought for this country once, taking on terrorists face to face - I 'm certainly not afraid to take on establishment politicians._**

We need strong leaders who will put the hardworking American people before special interests and the Clinton family insiders.

I've made a commitment to our country before, and now, I'm ready to make a new one as a U.S. Senator.

**[I'm not done with my mission for America, and I need your help to finish it. I'm asking humbly: will you chip in $5, $10, or $25 today to support our mission to take back the U.S. Senate and take out Hillary Clinton's last pawn in Washington?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z7canaisc42s7m9f7uqabijl6bbp5gvurc805s1g_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spi6coj4chh2bs)**

**[PITCH IN $10](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zpg4mao1m1ntjv62jtotc5vetulaa6tmrj51uj5o_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spi6coj4chh2bs)**

**[PITCH IN $25](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z1bhq7eq5ke4m0r14lbs0e2dvstv5s3bc69sdi88_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spi6coj4chh2bs)**

**[PITCH IN $50](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zcaj33vqklgobi7e2s8if21cd605u7bpuj8mmo7g_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spi6coj4chh2bs)**

**[PITCH IN $100](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zn2s2nn3nh84tfvbiscspv2l37foo28kilbtdj58_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spi6coj4chh2bs)**

**[PITCH IN OTHER AMOUNT](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2znl8jad8mkdadc85744ejs64a49emm28j1ols178_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spi6coj4chh2bs)**

Thank you,

name: Hung Cao
subject: You’ll want in on this ride
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Hung Cao for Virginia
body:
I fought for this country once, taking on terrorists face to face - I’m certainly not afraid to take on establishment politicians.

| | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zk9mc9299rev592pl03vo819chqku6dc1mef5tp0_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spi6ao36c1h238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj79rkmep7ac9jkorrbdt0mlpredd66grrb8pnm9qq6t5iesqb7d5k6uhn9dhheup79td0egrqfop5e5qrfkbm6ni145d2c1h62o33c9im68jl6oqn4sjkmerjbobielqj08h5u)
---
Fellow Patriot, My name is Hung Cao. I am a retired Navy Captain who served for 25 years in Special Operations. I served on the front lines defusing bombs for our SEAL teams and Special Forces; I also conducted some of the most dangerous deep dives in the military.
---
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zco3lcspq546ussg7giocqgg3qdlsfq5brod7eh8_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t6ekr3asjl6ejn9ctiekoj79hnmmrq1dbjmsqqcd1nmmhjfcjlkdqb4tpkmeqb8dt3eir32ttiejqq0t1nkvhiasblmv8ncdf428aq4o32c5g66oj5cch7adhle9p79ctn6ngn4tbl60h238h1e8he4937chiecp35c1j60oh5u)
---
I was inspired to serve because America gave me everything. **My family escaped Communist Vietnam to the United States after the fall of Saigon. **
---
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2ziufog0bcu0n477f1g2rmh143r27qnsqqh1g93lo_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spi6ao36c1h238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj79rkmep7ac9jkorrbdt0mlpredd66grrb8pnm9qq6t5iesqb7d5k6uhn9dhheup79td0egrqfop5e5qrfkbm6ni145d2c1h62o33c9im68jl6oqn4sjkmerjbobielqj08h5u)
---
_If it wasn’t for America, I probably wouldn’t be alive today._

**I answered the call to duty when I was appointed to the Naval Academy as a young man. Now, I’m answering the call of duty to Americans once again._But my new mission is a little different._**
---
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z40d6etcfqsblpj2vkbc7k91ooq64og8gccrgm6g_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spi6ao36c1h238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj79rkmep7ac9jkorrbdt0mlpredd66grrb8pnm9qq6t5iesqb7d5k6uhn9dhheup79td0egrqfop5e5qrfkbm6ni145d2c1h62o33c9im68jl6oqn4sjkmerjbobielqj08h5u)
---
**I****’m now the OFFICIAL GOP nominee running for the U.S. Senate in Virginia because our voters believe our country needs true conservative leaders who put service over self.**

[**In the general election, I need an A-team of patriots by my side if we****’****re going to bring my opponent, otherwise known as Hillary Clinton****’****s VP pick, Tim Kaine****’****s decades-long political career to an end. Will you step up and join our team today?**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zjh23g8a3gji492tqvc6tio1nm1tv59r57eak3g8_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t6ekr3asjl6ejn9ctiekoj79hnmmrq1dbjmsqqcd1nmmhjfcjlkdqb4tpkmeqb8dt3eir32ttiejqq0t1nkvhiasblmv8ncdf428aq4o32c5g66oj5cch7adhle9p79ctn6ngn4tbl60h238h1e8he4937chiecp35c1j60oh5u)
---
[**JOIN THE TEAM**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zu3qdilbsag39u1kejl787vqcbdnli80bdqiqb9o_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t6ekr3asjl6ejn9ctiekoj79hnmmrq1dbjmsqqcd1nmmhjfcjlkdqb4tpkmeqb8dt3eir32ttiejqq0t1nkvhiasblmv8ncdf428aq4o32c5g66oj5cch7adhle9p79ctn6ngn4tbl60h238h1e8he4937chiecp35c1j60oh5u)
---
[**SEND A NAVY VETERAN TO THE U.S. SENATE**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zsro5jb8233kupu61p273u0im0gr0a70tfd807rg_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spi6ao36c1h238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj79rkmep7ac9jkorrbdt0mlpredd66grrb8pnm9qq6t5iesqb7d5k6uhn9dhheup79td0egrqfop5e5qrfkbm6ni145d2c1h62o33c9im68jl6oqn4sjkmerjbobielqj08h5u)
---
I put my life on the line for our American values and freedom because I know that America is worth defending.

_But today, career politicians like Tim_ _“Hillary” Kaine are eroding the very liberties my fellow troops and I risked the ultimate sacrifice for._ They’ve lost sight of what matters and are more interested in playing political games than serving the people they’re supposed to represent.

_**Now, I’m stepping up because we need a change.**_

**_I fought for this country once, taking on terrorists face to face - I’m certainly not afraid to take on establishment politicians._**

We need strong leaders who will put the hardworking American people before special interests and the Clinton family insiders.

I’ve made a commitment to our country before, and now, I’m ready to make a new one as a U.S. Senator.

**I’m not done with my mission for America, and I need your help to finish it. I’m asking humbly:[will you chip in $5, $10, or $25 today to support our mission to take back the U.S. Senate and take out Hillary Clinton’s last pawn in Washington?](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zkvvfk761supp39r2c085gsheu8r2ks2ekmecnk8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spi6ao36c1h238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj79rkmep7ac9jkorrbdt0mlpredd66grrb8pnm9qq6t5iesqb7d5k6uhn9dhheup79td0egrqfop5e5qrfkbm6ni145d2c1h62o33c9im68jl6oqn4sjkmerjbobielqj08h5u)**
---
[**STAND WITH ME TODAY >>>**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zdcj9q29lu3gd10rbnf2ck1snu0i1fvs5usti3o0_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spi6ao36c1h238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj79rkmep7ac9jkorrbdt0mlpredd66grrb8pnm9qq6t5iesqb7d5k6uhn9dhheup79td0egrqfop5e5qrfkbm6ni145d2c1h62o33c9im68jl6oqn4sjkmerjbobielqj08h5u)
---
Answer this call to duty with me and let’s get America back on track.

Thank you,
---
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zeq89sk0eldritou39agalq80barh18hj1em2ejo_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spi6ao36c1h238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj79rkmep7ac9jkorrbdt0mlpredd66grrb8pnm9qq6t5iesqb7d5k6uhn9dhheup79td0egrqfop5e5qrfkbm6ni145d2c1h62o33c9im68jl6oqn4sjkmerjbobielqj08h5u)
---
CAPT Hung Cao, USN (Ret)Former Navy Special OperationsCandidate, U.S. Senate (VA)
---
|
---
---
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z11k869t09muo2eigresht2ca8m4s7oa8d0tan70_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spi6ao36c1h238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj79rkmep7ac9jkorrbdt0mlpredd66grrb8pnm9qq6t5iesqb7d5k6uhn9dhheup79td0egrqfop5e5qrfkbm6ni145d2c1h62o33c9im68jl6oqn4sjkmerjbobielqj08h5u)
---
Hung knows the American Dream is worth saving - because he’s lived it. Now, he’s running for Senate to defend it from the next generation. Hung Cao came to America with little besides the clothes on his back, and after his 25-year career in the Navy, he’s not done fighting for our future. If you’re on board for our fight for Virginia, [join our team and become an official supporter!](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zlulfq13c55ajs47qf2vb555rjetlcccfdgqd5v0_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t6ekr3asjl6ejn9ctiekoj79hnmmrq1dbjmsqqcd1nmmhjfcjlkdqb4tpkmeqb8dt3eir32ttiejqq0t1nkvhiasblmv8ncdf428aq4o32c5g66oj5cch7adhle9p79ctn6ngn4tbl60h238h1e8he4937chiecp35c1j60oh5u)

subject: Charlie Kirk and Colby Jenkins
body:
What you'll get from Colby Jenkins is a Republican who actually votes like a Republican should.
No images? [Click here](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-e-ekrmjd-trihsurjy-jt/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ekrmjd-trihsurjy-r/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ekrmjd-trihsurjy-y/)
### Dear Friends,
### Colby was able to join [Charlie Kirk on the Charlie Kirk Show](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ekrmjd-trihsurjy-j/) this morning. We hope you'll get the chance to click on the link to listen/watch as Colby and Charlie discuss important issues and why Colby is the best candidate to represent Utah's 2nd Congressional District.
* ### **He won't just say _America First_ , he'll vote America First. **
* ### **He will fight to control spending and defend the Constitution, not compromise against it.**
* ### **He won't be the same old Republican, controlled by the establishment, who is willing to rubber stamp anything they put in front of him. **
* ### **What you'll get from Colby Jenkins is a Republican who actually votes like a Republican should.**

### Please remember to vote! If you will be voting by mail, **TODAY IS THE LAST DAY** , mail-in ballots **must** be postmarked by June 24th or they won't be counted. You can also drop your ballot at a ballot dropbox location, or you can **vote in person tomorrow, Election Day (June 25, 2024) at an in person polling location**.
### To learn more about where or how to vote you can contact your local county clerk, or visit: [https://vote.utah.gov/](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ekrmjd-trihsurjy-t/).
### We hope we've been able to earn your support.
### Thank you,
### [Colby Jenkins for Congress](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ekrmjd-trihsurjy-i/)
[](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ekrmjd-trihsurjy-d/)
## [**MEET COLBY JENKINS**](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ekrmjd-trihsurjy-h/)
Colby Jenkins is a small-town Utah native, born and raised in Roosevelt, Utah. His family goes back generations in Utah. After graduating from Union High School, he was the first from his county to ever go to the United States Military Academy at West Point. He credits that "first" to his incredible high school counselor who believed in him, along with many coaches, teachers, and family members who all offered encouragement and support. He attended West Point for two years before departing to serve a two-year service mission in Brazil for the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. After his mission, he returned to West Point and later graduated as an Infantry Lieutenant before going on to become an Airborne Ranger. Following 9/11, he knew he needed to serve our nation at the highest level possible, so he prepared himself and tried out to become a Green Beret Special Forces officer. He was fortunate to be selected and went on to command a Special Forces A-team on multiple global deployments, including combat in Afghanistan and counter-drug and hostage rescue operations throughout South America, specifically in the jungles of Colombia.His experience and combat-tested leadership skills led to assignments in Washington, D.C., where he served as a Green Beret liaison to Congress and a counter-terrorism policy advisor to the Secretary of Defense. During his civilian career, he worked for several years in the Pentagon as the senior legislative advisor to the Vice-Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff. After working in the Pentagon, he transitioned to the corporate tech world, where he had opportunities to work with some of our world's most innovative people solving complex problems.He currently resides in St. George, Utah, where he serves as the Director of Tech Integration for a national telecommunications company while continuing his more than two decades of military service as a Colonel in the Army Reserve. He is married to Heather, and together they have two incredible daughters. [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ekrmjd-trihsurjy-c/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ekrmjd-trihsurjy-q/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ekrmjd-trihsurjy-a/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ekrmjd-trihsurjy-f/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ekrmjd-trihsurjy-z/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ekrmjd-trihsurjy-yh/)
## Iron County Commissioner Paul Cozzens:
"I have had many people call and ask my opinion on the election. This is one candidate I support 100%. I stand behind Colby Jenkins because he's a true patriot and a Green Beret who isn't afraid to challenge the entrenched powers in Washington. Colby has the support of Senator Mike Lee, which speaks volumes about his integrity and commitment. Colby has a proven track record of service and respect for our values. Unlike his opponent, Colby has never labeled Trump a dictator, and I cannot support some that didn't think it was important to vote in the last five elections and voted with speaker Mike Johnson and the Democrats to reauthorize warrantless surveillance of Americans under FISA 702." A few years ago, members of the world's elite met at the annual World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, and launched the Great Reset initiative.

What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

In short, they aim to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab--the founder and executive director of the Forum--wrote, "We need a 'Great Reset' of capitalism." If successful, their plan would also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

This initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt to impose global rule by so-called experts.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we can communicate directly with you.

In this seminar, we...
* Consider the idea of the Great Reset and its implications for America.
* Explore how the ideology of “woke capitalism” is infiltrating large corporations.
* Delve into pro-freedom alternatives to this tyrannical plan.

body:
Flooding in the Midwest caused a railroad bridge to collapse over the Big Sioux River and breached a dam in Minnesota, forcing residents to evacuate or be rescued from rising water.

| | |
---
| | |
# TUESDAY, JUNE 25, 2024
---|---
**Good Morning**! ## Supreme Court Takes On Transgender Laws
The U.S. Supreme Court agreed to hear arguments on a lawsuit challenging a Tennessee law [banning transgender treatments](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FuwyAQQL8Gtlj4OCAeGLp4S9eOFj6OhIoYy0a20q-v0rnbk570pPd1m24hl7zcP8OTfUt1CtTywZO9gLkATiijT8zAWrLvXT9owN6AfPhoAZ1TkTDpIRLhTASUktEDujg7mT0oQGXB9AoNXjvr4jUovkbSEFxggYpjbnXrvmte2oNTedWDt47qUxb_aG3dhf4QMAoYz_Ps5pneTsC48LkLGMPWMhV-I9l1Xe3L8PBT5ebjeuZS8m6dQHV_hlz-qu3_x8PDbwAAAP__CPhUCw) involving hormone therapy and puberty blockers for children. Nearly half the states in America have passed similar laws barring these therapies for children under 18, and this marks the first time the Supreme Court has agreed to rule on the constitutionality of those laws. The suit, brought by three transgender teens, their parents, and a doctor, argues that the ban violates equal protection under the law, as the same treatments are used for non-transgender children. The hearing is slated to take place [during the Court's next term](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFu7CAQQNGvgY4VHg9gFxSvcbevTWlhGNsTYbPC7Eb5-yhJm_oUV7pv9_keOPO5_Q8H-baWOcTGL5qtAqMAZ5TJr0RAvSTfuW7sATsDcvcjunUxYxoDLXowA9ohok0UoI-4JCfZgwbUFkyn0eBwsy4NQdOQYg_BBRKoKXEr9fZe-Gw7rfmzvKjeYjlk9ntrj0v0_wRMAqa20845f5uAqdL2zKFxOQVMsTxrU0toLdMlYELXW4Ooruej0kHq1zc6E1UV1pXrweemYqgkYJLVp8cH58yXdQL1dgT-ycj295CXh68AAAD__1b8Y-E), with oral arguments likely by the end of this year.

## Panthers Win Stanley Cup
The Florida Panthers [won game 7](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuhDAQBb_GdEb22pijcJHG3aVNiRy8HBsZjPDeofv7iNQpn540Gs3XfbxHyrQ9PuOKnucyxonphaOT0Emwo22SnxEBTYNe93owYHUHzeKds8q52ehv0_UDzNaZlDRqPaBVajANeVBglYNOK9vZW-v6dIsKb2kyEPuIwipMxOVofwptvOCc3-WFRzuVtcl-Yd6rMB8CgoBwnmeLdd-uU0DYliwgVC7HW0AYBQRKAoJVFpx2nYCwxwt5VFmenGNlWShf8xFXlL2c6agsK8ct41tOz10yccbm8Gk_KWeqrhdWPdZI-U-I_8_z8vAbAAD__yBEZpY) of the Stanley Cup Final last night, defeating the Edmonton Oilers 2-1 and hoisting the cup for the first time in franchise history. Sam Reinhart scored the second goal, and goalie Sergei Bobrovsky held off a desperate attack in the final period, grabbing 23 total saves. body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hello there,
It's PRIMARY DAY, folks! Make sure you get out and vote today if you haven't already. Here are some of our [top articles on the primary election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) if you are still unsure of who you're going to vote for. We hope we can offer you some clarity on what each candidate stands for.
Lastly, stay tuned for [LIVE TWEETS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) on the Rocky Mountain Voice [X/Twitter](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) account tonight for updates. We have RMV staff/volunteers at most of the candidate parties to bring you quality updates in real time.
This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, June 25, 2024.
- Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Washington County, where ballot count is low, but turnout dependably high](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
It is the home to every farmer's favorite diner, Mom's Kitchen, a county seat whose namesake is more synonymous with a major city in Ohio, and is [Colorado's leader in wheat production](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) at almost 5 million annual bushels.

The [rural landowners](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) here count their land in sections, not acres, and many routinely grow crops the old school way, without irrigation pivots.

The last Democratic President to win here was [Franklin D. Roosevelt in 1936](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Republicans have carried at least three-fourths of the Presidential vote here in each election since 2000 -- four of the last five by 80 percent or better.

Situated west of Yuma County, known here as Cory Gardner Country, and south of Logan County, the "backwards L" shaped Washington County is reliable for political candidates it gets behind, generally casting ballots at a [higher turnout rate](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) than about anywhere in the state.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Douglas County, cornerstone of a 4th District victory, has cast 49.1% of ballots in district](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Nearly half of the votes in [Colorado's 4th District](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) so far are from Douglas County, with the rest spread across 20 other counties.
* About 20% of registered voters [have already voted](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), predominantly from Douglas, Larimer, and Weld Counties, which together account for 72.9% of all votes.
* This distribution may benefit Republican frontrunners like Deborah Flora and Lauren Boebert, who have strong support in these counties, with Boebert also receiving [Trump's endorsement](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
* Candidates from the northeastern part of the district, such as Richard Holtorf and Jerry Sonnenberg, might find it challenging to compete due to [fewer ballots cast](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in their key regions.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[How public schools became ideological boot camps](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE FREE PRESS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Public schools across the U.S. often lack official oversight of curriculum materials, allowing teachers to use self-developed or externally sourced content [without formal approval](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). This has led to the introduction of biased and controversial educational content.
* A 2017 survey revealed that nearly all teachers [use their own materials](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), often influenced by various interest groups that provide free resources aimed at promoting specific ideologies. Platforms like Share My Lesson and Teachers Pay Teachers are popular sources for these materials.
* The autonomy granted to teachers in selecting educational content can lead to significant deviations from the intended curriculum, making "curriculum transparency" difficult to achieve. This situation often results in students receiving education that includes unapproved and potentially biased information, affecting the overall [educational integrity](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and exposing students to one-sided views on complex issues.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Blackmon: Supreme Court has a chance to torch one of the Left's favorite legal tactics](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE DAILY CALLER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_From fuel emissions standards to[gas-powered vehicle bans](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to far-reaching climate disclosure rules, states like California are constantly testing how far state laws can go in shaping national climate policy. But for nearly a decade, activists and leftwing lawmakers have simultaneously pursued a backdoor strategy that seeks to use state courtrooms, not state or national legislatures, to [sue oil and natural gas companies](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) into ceasing production and accomplishing their goal of shutting down American energy._
_Less flashy EV mandates and offshore wind subsidies, the barrage of suits filed against energy companies has flown[under the public's radar.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) That might be about to change: If a single one of these cases is successful, Americans across the country could soon be in for a rude awakening in the form of [skyrocketing gasoline and home energy prices](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)._ **[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Trump:'I happen to think he's incompetent' but warns against underestimating Biden in debate](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE DAILY CALLER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Donald Trump recognized Joe Biden as a "worthy debater" ahead of their [scheduled presidential debate](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) on June 27, recalling Biden's effective performance against Paul Ryan in a past debate.
* During an appearance on "The All-In Podcast," Trump criticized Biden's domestic and foreign policies but emphasized the importance of [not underestimating him](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
* While Trump avoided making direct statements about Biden's cognitive abilities, he expressed long-standing doubts about Biden's competence, referencing an opinion from a [Kennedy family member](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
* The debate format will give Trump [the final word](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), with Biden's podium positioned on the right side of the TV screen after a coin toss decided by Biden's campaign.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[A new rule aids ranchers in killing wolves attacking their livestock at night](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado Parks and Wildlife has authorized ranchers to use [artificial light at night to kill wolves](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) actively attacking livestock, reflecting an effort to mitigate the challenges from the recent reintroduction of wolves.
* The approval, [decided by a 6-4 vote](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), amends previous rules that barred shooting wolves at night, targeting times when wolves are most likely to attack.
* Ranchers can only [lethally target wolves](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) if they are directly observed attacking livestock, with the aim of preventing potential abuse of this permission.
* Concerns were raised about the [misuse of this rule](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and its conservation implications, but the commission did not require recording devices with night vision that could verify such incidents.
* The [policy adjustments](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) also include a new 45-day permit for addressing chronic wolf depredations and expanded compensation for ranchers for livestock losses due to wolf attacks.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

body:
Politics, Partnerships, & Team Red State Nebraska

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/fdfa42c93792/n41kepo7ku-12701525?e=25844e23a8)
https://ne.gop/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=93d29615f3-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-93d29615f3-21732365

** Good Morning Republicans,
------------------------------------------------------------
Isaiah 53:6 All of us, like sheep, have strayed away. We have left God's path to follow our own. Yet the LORD laid on him the sins of us all.
Summer is in full swing. VBS weeks are blessing our children and church families. Vacations are beginning or being planned. Nebraskans are camping, and traveling, and in full swing of summer sports activities. Farmers and ranchers have been blessed with early rains and the first bailing is complete. Corn is on it's way to being as high as an elephants eye by 4th of July. Independence Day activities and parade seasons and huge gatherings and conventions are coming up.
Life never slows down, does it?
------------------------------------------------------------
The political world doesn't slow down either. Which can seem daunting at times and bring fatigue as well. However, we have to understand that there is a balance that must be found. There are times to go all out or being All In, and then there are times to rest. Personally, I can't rest. There is too much at stake for this country and for the future of my children.
To find that balance, though, a person must define a bit more and ask one major question about politics...
What is "Politics", really?
As I've immersed myself in the business of politics and developed relationships over these last four years of being in leadership positions, politics is really a lens on how you view life...it's either,
1. Public servitude of, by, & for The People...OR,
2. Power, money, control and influence of, by, & for Special Interests including their own.
>From these two completely OPPOSITE cultures, I encourage you to step back (not step away), but step back from politics and assess results/achievements of those whom we seemingly trust to represent us Federal and Locally.
And then understand this...politics is NOT a mystic realm of knowledge, insight, skills, talents unattainable to the "commoners" with only elites able to process and maneuver effectively through.
Noooo...politics is pretty simple and basic, but made purposefully chaotic by those who wish to suppress change, because politics will ALWAYS involve Human Nature...and there will be those who follow a path laid of their own, or a path laid before them by God.
What comes with Human Nature is the simple human emotions and those usually reveal themselves during times of change.
You will see people become fearful, vengeful, angry, and resentful because of change.
You will see people become passionate, enthuisastic, empowered, and optimistic because of change.
One side of this will try to suppress change and another side will encourage change.
Make no mistake, change has come to the Republican party culture over the last 7-8 years albeit slowly. There are those who embrace it, join it, grow it, and call others to assemble in the ideals of our Nations founding truths. This culture of change may seem chaotic at first, but I see the stability settling the dust as more and more true patriots bring their time, talents, and treasures.
Because "politics" should not be a LIFE pursuit, but a calling to do something for others. And throughout history, the reason believers don't heed any calling from God is ALWAYS because a worldly idol distracted or disenfranchised them from trusting God's path. In politics, the worldly idol is usually "Other People" and their opinions of you, assessment of you, or whether they'll "like" you.
STOP believing that you are NOT a difference maker.
STOP believing that those in position of power or with titles, KNOW better because of said position or title.
STOP giving control of your life, liberty, and pursuit of happiness to others who have absolutely, genuinely, literally NO concern over your life, liberty, and pursuit of happiness.
If they DID have concern...they would have engaged you locally, where you are at, and found solutions to the landscape of living the Good Life in Nebraska. They would have the ability to ASSESS and conceptualize the risks and growing agenda's of the radical Liberals and they WOULD have DONE something about it by now. They would see beyond each election cycle and just "electing Republicans" but to a genuine desire to be difference makers and not king makers.
So, you say to yourself, how or where do I even begin to make a difference then?
At your County GOP level is where you will find the teams being assembled to take back this country! These County GOP's can then be a vessel to connect to the NEGOP. The NEGOP, a statewide assembling of like-minded, like-hearted, and even like-spirited true LEADERS who have the genuine desire to further our principles within the communities and see YOU be a part of this growth, because they see you as a part of the team...we are a team. Team Nebraska, TeamNE for short! A team built to keep Nebraska politically as a Red State. Team Red State Nebraska.
A team titled to follow, promote, encourage, grow our Constitutional and Platform Republicans. A team assembled on values and purpose from Scottsbluff to Omaha, Panhandle to every corner of the state.
Leaders of the party, coming from all walks of life, who use the NEGOP Platform as the defining original-source document to create commonality in the discussions on how to campaign, govern, or operate as an Elected Representative of the Republican party. Leaders from their communities, bringing their life perspectives, to honor our National, State, and Party Constitutions as the defining original-source documents to promote fairness and stability, rules and process for operations, so all are welcomed and encouraged to participate.
As our NEGOP constitution outlines, the membership of the party is all those who support the objectives of the party. The objective to maintain the government of, by, and for the people AND to further our principles within the community. Imagine the UNITY that comes from Principles being first and Personalities being LAST as a culture of membership.
Together, we have brought STABILITY to this party. The years of work to provide and create resources are bringing results. In next weeks Coffee w/ the Chairman, I will outline more details to the partnerships being created to further OUR principles in Nebraska. Local coalitions and even national partners from coalitions like Turning Point Action and national influencers, to the Republican structured resources of the Trump Force 47, RNC, NRCC, NRSC, and Governors Associations are choosing to be a part of change. These entities are choosing to be a part of the change in Nebraska that you have worked so hard for.
NOW...we must go to the people with our principles. Over the next month, these partnerships will lead to real action at the door and through Days of Action. That's what the next FIVE months are about and then even beyond November 5th. We must not stop, because we have major municipality races in 2025 for Omaha and Lincoln, and we have to ready for 2026 Statewide races.
WE...MUST...CONNECT...TO...THE PEOPLE. At their doors. MISSION CRITICAL, door knocking and then INVITING them to a GOP meeting.
DONATE (https://ne.gop/donate/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=93d29615f3-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-93d29615f3-21732365) to the NEGOP. DONATE to your local GOP.
https://ne.gop/45in45/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=93d29615f3-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-93d29615f3-21732365
We will put your dollars to work connecting to more Republican voters state-wide.
We will put your dollars to work defeating Democrats at the local level.

We have plenty of work to do with Legislation Support, support of candidates, connecting to coalition partners, event planning, and discussing the different committee's and groups need to be successful in 2024!
The truth shall set us free.
Blessings,
–Chairman Underwood

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bea2d148-4001-473c-a8bf-0ea8c113d2aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Elizabeth Wolf. Credit: Euless Police Department
While the story is just now coming to light, in late May, Wolf was arrested for attempting to drown a 3-year-old Palestinian Muslim girl and attacking her 6-year-old brother. This, after yelling Islamophobic and racist epithets at the child's mother. As police arrived and led Wolf away, she screamed at the Palestinian mother, "**Tell her I will kill her and I will kill her whole family**."
And as if all that wasn't shocking enough, despite her open hate crime and attempted murder of a child--Wolf is out on cash bail. The Euless, [Texas Police Department said](https://substack.com/redirect/4b10a9bc-ecbe-41fc-a2fa-d6f709b53c67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that Wolf was held in Tarrant County Jail but had successfully posted bail, and was released:
> 'The bond for the Attempted Capital Murder charge was $25,000. The bond for the Injury to a Child charge was $15,000,' Captain Brenda Alvarado said.
The mother, whose name is being kept confidential for her own safety, [said](https://substack.com/redirect/2ab7b0ef-7186-465c-ba5d-5761a5bd9f9e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> We are American citizens, originally from Palestine, and I don't know where to go to feel safe with my kids. My country is facing a war, and we are facing that hate here.

Civil rights groups are documenting the sharp rise in anti-Muslim and anti-Arab hate crimes. Fresh in our memories is the brutal murder of [6-year-old Wadea al-Fayoume](https://substack.com/redirect/24fe4733-702a-4c92-9741-172f9608af47?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Plainfield, IL at the hands of a racist man radicalized by anti-Palestinian hate.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9f28da5e-1ca6-48ab-b340-2b04c67e76ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
6-year-old Wadea Al-Fayoume
Likewise, [three Palestinian students were shot at in Vermont](https://substack.com/redirect/ebb748e5-49ef-494d-900a-304c9735d3ec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for "speaking Arabic and wearing keffiyyahs." It is critical we recognize these stories to remember these hate crimes are not just statistics, but behind each of of violence is an innocent person who wants nothing more than to live in peace and safety.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/96d51a2d-bc82-4075-99e0-b19411d1248f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

From left, Tahseen Ali Ahmad, Kinnan Abdalhamid and Hisham Awartani. Credit: Institute for Middle East Understanding

The normalization of Islamophobic bigotry and dehumanization has reached historic highs. It is imperative we continue to raise our voices to ensure our elected representatives hear us. Every child, Israeli and Palestinian, Muslim and Jewish, deserves to live in safety and with their humanity. Right now, the unprecedented assault on Palestinian children in Gaza and throughout the United States, demands our attention to stop these ongoing injustices.

body:

|

| Peter, **Are you ready to put an end to the latest left-wing lunacy plaguing New Jersey?** The misguided push to ban gas cars in our great state is a direct assault on the jobs and livelihoods of thousands of our fellow citizens.
---
|
---
Last week's massive protest hosted by the NJBIA at the Statehouse in Trenton sent a powerful message: **New Jerseyans won't stand for these radical policies that threaten our economic security and personal freedoms.**
---
| Many local leaders, from union workers to local mayors, stood united under one cause—our right to choose how we power our lives.
**Why This Fight Matters:** Our state is on the frontline of a national movement dictated by out-of-touch bureaucrats who'd rather see us dependent on unreliable and unaffordable electric vehicles. This isn't just about cars; it's about preserving the American dream of choice and mobility.
At the Common Sense Club, we're dedicated to halting the spread of these unreasonable measures. We're rallying everyone who believes in practical, sensible governance to join us. It's time to drive out the overreaching hand of the government that threatens to dictate every aspect of our lives. [**If you haven't already, join us today**](https://xtz223.keap-link002.com/v2/click/040e4d1fb8e2a684243602cbaae9eec3/eJyNkMsOgjAQRf9l1ghScMPOGEIa0IXRtWlglCqUpowiEv7d-ogrTVzfc8_kzgCESijiBURwpRtjAThgMJdaoqJFo0jkz5TNQj_wHaikOiWmOWuIhq_lD_BshVPmAPUaLbJZzxcpXyW7jK9SS2ph7I0_PSz8eOLlnGcwjj_FWEuKL9bdQkTmjI9FhbSraGsqy5dEuo08r-s699hIRSXu5aEkNmWhmze1h7WQ1eQRWZvQGlXxfkWK_cs53gEcN2bs) and be part of a movement that values freedom, champions economic prosperity, and fights against the overreach of government. Your membership will support our efforts to mobilize New Jerseyans and Americans across the nation to push back against these harmful policies. By joining, you're not just gaining a membership; you're taking a stand for freedom. Together, we will ensure that policies reflect common sense and respect for individual choice—not unchecked government control.

subject: COYNE FLIP: Safe Suburbs PAC Endorses Pro-SAFE-T Democrat Despite Calling Law "Dangerous"
body:
Kevin Coyne made a name for himself calling out the SAFE-T Act. Now he endorses a Top Democrat who is pro-SAFE-T Act and pro-cashless bail.

Dear Peter,

The crime epidemic has hit Cook County hard. And it's not just in isolated parts of Chicago. Crime has spread north to the once Magnificent Mile. And it's spread out to the suburbs, aided by Democrat prosecutors who won't enforce the law. If it couldn't get any worse, it did: Governor Pritzker pushed through the SAFE-T Act that did away with cash bail and has handcuffed not the criminals but the ability of law enforcement officers to do their jobs. Over the last three years, many politicians have made names for themselves calling out the pitfalls of the SAFE-T Act. And now we're learning that for at least one, it was nothing more than hollow words.
FLIP FLOP: Safe Suburbs PAC Founder Kevin Coyne Endorses Pro-SAFE-T Act Chicago Democrat Despite Calling the Law "Dangerous" and "Emboldening Law Breakers" (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/flip-flop-safe-suburbs-pac-founder-kevin-coyne-endorses-pro-safe-t-act-chicago-democrat-despite-calling-the-law-dangerous-and-emboldening-law-breakers.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=468cabcca7-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/flip-flop-safe-suburbs-pac-founder-kevin-coyne-endorses-pro-safe-t-act-chicago-democrat-despite-calling-the-law-dangerous-and-emboldening-law-breakers.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=468cabcca7-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Soft-on-crime Democrat candidate for Cook County State's Attorney, Eileen O'Neill Burke, left, and Safe Suburbs PAC Founder Kevin Coyne.

By Illinois Review
Safe Suburbs USA PAC founder Kevin Coyne has spent the last two years criticizing the SAFE-T Act, which passed both chambers of the Illinois legislature with unanimous Democratic support back in 2022 – arguing that the law (https://patch.com/illinois/naperville/naperville-officials-please-sound-alarm-safe-t-act-nodx?fbclid=IwAR0wLHKBIM34MMTdkz6yMZ7C0n6KBp8Bj46SO5RW7zcxnGl1JNSRnUvKHhg&fs=e&s=cl&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=468cabcca7-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) is “dangerous” and would “undermine law enforcement’s ability to protect public safety.”

But in a list just released by Coyne’s PAC highlighting the candidates the pro-public safety and pro-law enforcement organization will be
endorsing (https://safesuburbsusa.com/2024-endorsements/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=468cabcca7-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) during the 2024 election cycle, one name sticks out: Chicago Democrat Eileen O’Neill Burke who is running for Cook County State’s Attorney – who not only endorsed the controversial SAFE-T Act, but said (https://www.aclu-il.org/en/ccsa-burke?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=468cabcca7-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , “The passage of the SAFE-T Act exemplifies a significant step towards reforming our laws to prioritize fair outcomes over systemic biases.”
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/flip-flop-safe-suburbs-pac-founder-kevin-coyne-endorses-pro-safe-t-act-chicago-democrat-despite-calling-the-law-dangerous-and-emboldening-law-breakers.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=468cabcca7-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

In an opinion piece published in the Patch (https://patch.com/illinois/naperville/naperville-officials-please-sound-alarm-safe-t-act-nodx?fbclid=IwAR0wLHKBIM34MMTdkz6yMZ7C0n6KBp8Bj46SO5RW7zcxnGl1JNSRnUvKHhg&fs=e&s=cl&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=468cabcca7-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) in August 2022, Coyne alerted local Naperville residents – where he resides, to “Please sound the alarm on the SAFE-T Act,” noting that the law “undermines law enforcement’s ability to protect public safety.” Coyne also highlighted the fact that “100 of Illinois’ 102 elected State’s Attorneys have publicly condemned this law.” The Safe Suburbs USA PAC founder then concluded his article with,

“To all of Naperville elected leaders, please send a loud and clear message that the City of Naperville values public safety as its highest priority and that the numerous problematic provisions within this bill (notably free bail) should be removed from this widely condemned law.”
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/flip-flop-safe-suburbs-pac-founder-kevin-coyne-endorses-pro-safe-t-act-chicago-democrat-despite-calling-the-law-dangerous-and-emboldening-law-breakers.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=468cabcca7-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

In August of 2021 – the year Coyne founded the Safe Suburbs USA PAC, he gave an interview with the Chicago City Wire (https://chicagocitywire.com/stories/606545319-coyne-a-lot-of-legislation-seems-to-embolden-law-breakers?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=468cabcca7-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) where he discussed the SAFE-T Act and how it favors the criminals, saying, “You look at repeat criminals and they are not being held accountable and that’s partly because a lot of legislation seems to embolden law breakers. People are very upset about crime and want to see something different.” And the goal of the new PAC, according to Coyne, was to “push and support as many pro-public safety candidates for office as the group can.”

But the endorsement of O’Neill Burke – a Chicago Democrat, runs contradictory to the mission of the PAC. On September 15, 2023, the Cook County State’s Attorney candidate released a
video message (https://www.justiceforcookcounty.com/2023/09/15/video-eileen-oneill-burke-on-the-safe-t-act-as-criminal-justice-reform-goes-into-effect-on-monday/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=468cabcca7-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) reiterating her support of the SAFE-T Act, saying,

“The SAFE-T Act is a seminal piece of legislation. It’s also known as the Pretrial Fairness Act. What it does is it changes the way we detain people pretrial...We cannot fail in its implementation, and that’s why the role of the state’s attorney and this election is so vitally important.”

https://youtu.be/tfWQ2LBDpRA?si=uqrwdAxrH4fwWg7f&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=468cabcca7-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

I want to take a moment to remind you of my journey to the U.S. Senate, the important le ssons I have learned along the way, and why I continue to believe wholeheartedly in our beloved state.

My father, a World War II veteran, left school during the Great Depression to join the Army. Though he only had a ninth grade education, he built a career as a hard-working cement finisher. My mother, a dedicated voter who never missed an election, instilled in me the importance of civic duty.

From my parents, I inherited an unwavering love for this country that I have proudly carried throughout my life. It's something I strive to keep alive in Wyoming.

Later, in medical school, I learned the importance of having a plan before taking action, a lesson that has proven invaluable in both my medical career and my service as your senator. Just as in surgery, effective leadership requires a clear vision and a strategic approach to problem-solving.

As you may know, I am sometimes referred to as _"Wyoming's doctor,"_ but to be honest, that is what I have always strived to be as your senator. I have wholeheartedly dedicated myself to serving the state, addressing its challenges, and making it the best it can be.

**_Whether it's advocating for our veterans, championing American energy security, or safeguarding our borders, I've always strived to be a voice for all Wyoming people. Your concerns are my concerns, and your aspirations are my aspirations._**

As we look towards the future, I'm confident that Wyoming has the potential to be an even stronger, more prosperous state. **[But it will require strong leadership, a clear vision, and your continued support.](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=5b725cc6509f48eb9df6f9e1f7e028de&_e=eCKCCNqIvjETwr2NJO_XeLMZTZ9hS4WWmdv9v4Bnf0DdN6csqVI97xwGH8duZO2ZBI4Iuq9qAhNcZN_thkuUErL3DdGenV2l_A-GDDjjG1am55kSAOMBF1WS-Xq5U8FM7gbQRrCBW7Q9cIEE296cZJmzTqBWypp-swb9YiFj2K70styBX80HMzTgIOR-lUeuYs8ushWousIpkHdC2vkM--m50j1Cl8tjrwbCO73uHcR-puHzCfo4aJ1VxlSWFKhudra0sbqe535fWHIe952a-w%3D%3D)**

Already, your support has been instrumental in my journey, and I promise to continue fighting for the issues that matter most to Wyoming families.

Sincerely,
Senator John Barrasso [CHIP IN FOR A STRONG WYOMING](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=5b725cc6509f48eb9df6f9e1f7e028de&_e=eCKCCNqIvjETwr2NJO_XeLMZTZ9hS4WWmdv9v4Bnf0DdN6csqVI97xwGH8duZO2ZBI4Iuq9qAhNcZN_thkuUErL3DdGenV2l_A-GDDjjG1am55kSAOMBF1WS-Xq5U8FMic_6BdLoIKOU8Jntb4CRZKoOy8wF-9xc7Wm2OyU5aOb1pGVw2iJSGnlW1inqolr2dT034eBVlVE8uolUBLvdr0KGH1hQxgdejoFgI2Hhfbs3FT5DGC0rJJu5nijMB2RcgpdThkP-UH8HUSv24h87Tw%3D%3D)

name: Christa Kinsley
subject: Mario for Congress: ELECTION DAY!
body:
Good morning!

The big day is finally here!! Primary Election Day!!

VOTE!! Be sure to get out and vote for Mario and remind others to do the same.

SIGNS!! In addition to voting, one final way you can help boost support for Mario is to make sure your polling place has one of our signs nearby for people to see when they go to vote. No campaign images are allowed closer than 100 feet to the polling place, but usually the end of the street corner near a polling place is a great spot. Grab your yard sign from your yard when you go to vote, and if you don't see one of our signs, put yours there! And of course, if there's already a sign, put it back in your yard so we can continue the visibility one more day.

Let's do everything we can to remind people today is the day to vote and to vote for Mario Fratto for Congress!

Thank you as always for your continued support.

Best regards,
Christa Kinsley
Field Director
Phone or text 315-399-7313

That’s why we need 50,000 Democrats to add their names to this petition and let the GOP know: We won’t let them destroy the vital programs that millions of Americans count on. | | | * | = A note from Kirsten: Friend, I can’t thank you enough for standing by my side in the critical fights ahead of us. As Democrats face our toughest Senate map in decades, I need your help more than ever. While Republicans only have to defend 10 seats in 2024, Democrats have to defend 23 — and if the GOP flips just two of them, it will deliver Senate control back to Mitch McConnell. Now, experts at FiveThirtyEight are saying that the GOP has a clear path to the majority. As right-wing special interests gear up to pour millions into flipping the Senate, we need to fight back right now. But I refuse to take a single cent from corporate PACs, which means I’m relying on your grassroots support. = And if you’d like to become a core member of my team and receive exclusive texts from my campaign, = Thank you, Kirsten Gillibrand
