#
_* Sent in support of Ruben Gallego for Arizona and Lucas Kunce for Missouri *_
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/53159?refcode=em20240625-5852&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5852%2E614464%2EJz1Azs)
Peter, I got a few free minutes here. No calls, no meetings. I know that doesn’t sound like much, but with a newborn at home, chaos in Congress, and a campaign to run... trust me, it’s a gift.
And I know we send a lot of emails already, but I wanted to take a few of those minutes to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you.
The truth is, when I jumped in this race I had no idea how things were going to go. I didn’t know if this was going to be a two-way race, a three-way race, a thirty-way race. We had no clue what things would look like at this point.
But things have changed. This race is locked in now, and Kari Lake is my opponent — someone way more interested in burning our democracy down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about unity, or reaching across the aisle. She is in this for herself, and for Trump.
And if she wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for Arizona and the country. She’s dangerous. Really.
**She’s also been raising a ton of money lately, and that’s extremely concerning. There’s a real chance that she takes this Senate seat. The polls are incredibly close, and the pundits all say this is one of the most likely states in the country to flip.**
One of the biggest FEC deadlines of the entire campaign is right around the corner, and when it hits we’re going to be legally required to release our fundraising numbers.
If we’re going to defeat Kari Lake, hold on to the Senate, and defeat Donald Trump, I’m going to need a ton of support from people like you. We need to show a lot of our strength in this FEC report.
So, please:

disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
#

U.S. Surgeon General Vivek Murthy just declared gun violence a public health crisis in an official advisory.
This is a huge deal.
Never before has the nation’s top doctor urged gun violence to be treated as what it is: a public health crisis.
Gun violence is the number one cause of death for American kids, and GIFFORDS is leading the fight to keep pressure on our lawmakers to act. We’ve been calling for this action for years.
[**Please make a contribution right now to send a message that we’re demanding action from our leaders to end gun violence. Every donation will help us elect more gun safety champions and put the pressure on politicians in Washington who rubber stamp the gun lobby’s agenda.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-june24.gd3XnS&refcode=em240625-1-30&t=1&akid=8377%2E3935704%2ERd15So)
Gun violence causes unimaginable pain and loss in communities all across the country—and all of it is preventable. Our leaders must take immediate action to combat this crisis that kills nearly 44,000 Americans each year.
That’s exactly what this advisory calls for—with clear, actionable steps that could be taken today to save lives.
The advisory calls for closing loopholes in U.S. background check laws, requiring safe and secure storage of firearms, investing in community violence intervention, and increased oversight of the gun industry.
All of this would build upon the foundation of the _Bipartisan Safer Communities Act_. That historic law was signed into law by President Biden two years ago today—the most significant gun safety legislation passed in nearly 30 years.
Over the years, we’ve changed the game and proven that action on gun safety is not only the right thing to do, but the winning thing to do. But our work is far from over. So long as gun violence is a public health crisis, we cannot rest.
[**Please pitch in whatever you can today to support Gabby’s work at GIFFORDS to end gun violence in America. It would mean a lot, especially today on the anniversary of the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act and 5 days from the end-of-quarter deadline.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-june24.gd3XnS&refcode=em240625-1-30&t=2&akid=8377%2E3935704%2ERd15So)

# **Colin Allred**
---
| | | |
---
| | | | I'm a fourth-generation Texan who was raised in Dallas by a single mom. My mother taught in public schools and sometimes even worked an extra job to get by. Thanks to her, my teachers and coaches, and the good folks at our local YMCA, I went on to play football for Baylor and in the NFL before becoming a civil rights lawyer. **Then I ran for Congress to serve the community that raised me.** I'm running for Senate because I don't want my story to be the exception. I want all kids, no matter where they're from or what they're facing, to have what they need to achieve their dreams. **Will you chip in to help me defeat Ted Cruz and give Texas families the senator we deserve? →**
---
| [Donate Now](http://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2tugwu-dy6jq0-kyd76rh9/)
---

I also helped pass the CHIPS and Science Act, which is bringing high-tech manufacturing to our state. Ted Cruz voted against both of these **_bipartisan_** bills. **_Ted Cruz would rather deny Texans vital investments we need than reach across the aisle._** He's one of the most divisive legislators in Congress and has spent his whole career pitting people against each other. I have a very different record of bringing people together – in fact, I was just named the most bipartisan member of the Texas delegation. [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/bf4ee5b4-1db6-450b-9398-41b4c5e3c7dc-Screenshot2024-06-11at8.53.31AM.png]
Peter,
I first ran for Congress on a platform that pivoted on gun safety legislation. And in my first term, we passed a bipartisan bill that will take guns out of dangerous hands. But I’m still running hard on this issue – and supporting the Democrats in tough races who will provide the votes to save lives.
As a father, I know how desperate families are for solutions to our nation’s gun violence epidemic. And as a Marine officer, I slept, ate, trained, and patrolled with an assault weapon for four years — I know that no Walmart should sell them.
Gun violence is the leading cause of death for children in the United States. This is a preventable policy choice, and it’s the direct result of Members of Congress caving to the gun lobby.
That’s why I started my Beyond Thoughts and Prayers PAC to support Democrats who will be the voice and vote for gun violence prevention legislation in Congress.
Split a donation between my Beyond Thoughts and Prayers PAC and MassDems today to help elect and protect Democrats to take back the House and pass meaningful legislation to stop the scourge of gun violence. June 25, 2024
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
CONTACT: Houston Keene
press@nancyforalaska.com

Dahlstrom Endorsed by International Union of Police Associations

ANCHORAGE, AK - As crime runs rampant in America under Joe Biden and
Mary Peltola, law enforcement agencies are looking for real leadership.
They recognize who will actually make a difference when handed the
reins of power, and who will sit idly by as our friends, families, and
neighbors are ravaged by criminals. That's why they're choosing to
endorse Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom for Congress.

On Tuesday, that support continued. The International Union of Police
Associations endorsed Lt. Governor Dahlstrom to represent them and all
of Alaska in the U.S. House of Representatives. The Association
represents active duty, rank and file law enforcement professionals
across the United States.

"As the former commissioner of the Alaska Department of Corrections, I
know firsthand the dangers that our law enforcement officers face every
day on the job. I know that, especially with the amount of anti-police
rhetoric being spewed from elected leaders who supposedly support them,
it is much harder for them to do their jobs," said Lt. Governor Nancy
Dahlstrom. "We need to support our men and women in blue across Alaska
and America. I will continue to do so as your congresswoman and I
sincerely thank the International Union of Police Associations for
their endorsement."

clean_body: | | | Fellow Patriot, My name is Hung Cao. I am a retired Navy Captain who served for 25 years in Special Operations. I served on the front lines defusing bombs for our SEAL teams and Special Forces; I also conducted some of the most dangerous deep dives in the military. Now, I 'm answering the call of duty to Americans once again. But my new mission is a little different. I put my life on the line for our American values and freedom because I know that America is worth defending. But today, career politicians like Tim " Hillary" Kaine are eroding the very liberties my fellow troops and I risked the ultimate sacrifice for. They've lost sight of what matters and are more interested in playing political games than serving the people they're supposed to represent. Now, I 'm stepping up because we need a change. I fought for this country once, taking on terrorists face to face - I 'm certainly not afraid to take on establishment politicians. We need strong leaders who will put the hardworking American people before special interests and the Clinton family insiders. I've made a commitment to our country before, and now, I'm ready to make a new one as a U.S. Senator. I 'm not done with my mission for America, and I need your help to finish it. | | | | | Peter, It's been two years since the disastrous Supreme Court decision that overturned Roe v. Wade. Since then, our country has faced a reproductive health crisis, and a draconian near-total abortion ban has taken effect in Florida. Medical procedures have turned into felonies. Radicalized state legislatures have passed laws from the 1800s. Extremists are emboldened, and not even birth control is safe anymore. Peter, this has to end. And in Florida, we can end it in November. There’s an amendment on the Florida ballot that, if passed, would enshrine abortion rights into the state constitution and OVERTURN the near-total abortion ban. [We’re turning this awful anniversary into a call to action. We’re aiming to raise $100,000 by the end of this week to get out the vote in Florida to OVERTURN the near-total abortion ban. | | | | | The numbers are on our side, Peter. In order for the amendment to pass, we need 60% of voters to vote YES. Recent polling shows that 69% of Florida voters support the right to an abortion. Friend, He's with me now as I run for the most competitive Senate race in the country. **[Through the good times and bad, God has given me guidance and the comfort that I'm never alone.](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=71e6f52aaca34b42aa4befc0bf884264&_e=JegmZW73dLpHycAbPp6KB8CT1Leg0El5s62diUpyzy8ot1nIlRFbdplr6T3Pktolfm8mMICn7yR__-zMK2WEgSEGtB0eHlD1fve1Cu1HWXex3FUGPyH-id0dEOL89ir1ZHMFuDJEs7heQMnL7n6HF7DRwkpVHN1JRLYBxupdV8lorH1NdW5uD-fveEpFcw7cwqHQ_8hpoWhrFCPHGkelJzWUTIOms4z1cVZQRXXTk0IJg1b1Bg9ZWioWYthwkM-He3XGNzvw-6Lf38uYyNdDQQuvZGP3TxVfWgBgpwgM2whh5qTTRjA5u5p0sxfNY0277lxlMJif8hNzOXNS3dnJhFDCa4VYCw0hHFSh1s3FUnx83E6_bwqiMKtANqDAWj34twh9spt8Grove7So-puvKmna1sXrSDu6V9zNsnHzVyq7E5hf9HZgmrD6I0UejOWbGq20lLEt7xsD1IjG4iA2jA%3D%3D)** You see, our campaign isn't like others. name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: What are your thoughts?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vs7BUZAWNH
ACI - Religious Liberty Survey

I am fearful that legal persecution will intensify
against Americans holding to faith-based values
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/os7BUZAWNH

Fellow
American,

There is
a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me
worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values.

After the
Respect for Marriage Act was passed by a bi-partisan effort and
signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only
intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who
wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Are you
concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our
founding-Religious Liberty?

In
addition to the passing of the Respect for Marriage Act, numerous
examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v.
BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL
RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few
examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to
faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to
their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the Respect for Marriage Act,
brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal
Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and
organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex
marriage failed.

This has
the potential to only intensify legal persecution against
individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to
faith-based values.

The
American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to
preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation
for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty,
Community, and Life.

Whether
it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield
after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a
cake that violates his religious values, are you concerned as I
am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who
wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?

Please
share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning
religious liberty in America.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63330580:s7BUZAWNH:m:3:2627245898:78C3A0725D5AD5E6DD78278F512265C2:r

Thank you
for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben
Carson
Founder &
Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

Your
donation to ACI helps us to focus on our mission of promoting and
preserving individual and religious liberty, helping our
country's most vulnerable find new hope, and developing methods
to decrease the federal government's role in society and to
improve efficiency to best serve ALL our nation's citizens.

| I hope this letter finds you well. As we approach a critical moment in our nation’s history, I am writing to you to ask for your support in my campaign to become the congressional representative in Georgia’s 12th district.

Our community faces numerous challenges that require strong, dedicated leadership. I am, as I always have been, committed to job growth, a living wage, affordable housing and homeownership, excellent education for our children and equal access to healthcare for every member of our community.

With your support we can ensure that these values are represented in Georgia’s 12th district and in the great state of Georgia. Here are some key goals of our campaign:

* **Make sure we embrace, empower and engage voters.**

* **Grow my online presence to reach more voters, especially young voters and those who are registered yet have never voted.**

* **Get my message of how I will fight for a better quality of life for all, to as many people as possible including door to door conversations with voters and those who may have challenges getting to the polls on election day.**

However, to make this vision a reality, we need your help. Campaigns are won through the hard work and dedication of supporters like you. Your contribution will directly impact our ability to reach more voters, spread our message, and secure a victory in the upcoming election.

I was born a hillbilly in the foothills of Appalachia.

I was raised by my Mamaw and Papaw.

**This is JD Vance - now I'm a U.S. Senator standing in the breach for the left behind and forgotten folks who made this country great but were abandoned by the political class.**

The same corrupt elites allowing...
- Liberal operatives to prosecute the leader of our Party
- Entitled brats to desecrate our monuments
- Activists to spew anti-American propaganda in our schools
- Chinese-made fentanyl to decimate families and kill our kids
- Illegal aliens to take the jobs of hardworking Americans
It's a disgrace but hear this: Blue collar, white collar, or no collar - I will always stand between you and the Democrat Machine as it plunges our country into ruin.

_But you and I both know the strength of our movement comes down to our numbers._ Millions of Americans elected President Trump, millions stepped up when he was convicted, and millions more will help save this country from the corrupt Liberal elites.

So here's my final pitch to you, Friend:

This will be the most expensive election in American history. By a lot. The Democrat Machine has always crushed us in fundraising. **We have the message. We have the candidates. We have the leader - and we can win it all. **

_But that takes everyone stepping up right now. Not tomorrow. Not in October. Right here and now._

_**[That's why I'm teaming up with Majority Leader Steve Scalise to raise a million dollars by the end of the month to get our message out to the people, register voters in key states, and turn them out to VOTE REPUBLICAN up and down the ballot.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e85878745bc94820b6a4a5e2aa8ca974&_e=Vdu3xZb3FxRnaqCumEcp76iLR8lG2eSt0E_90sMNji9M-ik-d0VbGbrrXCWxd2UawchE4f9tZhBKIiuoB8sKjhxiUKU0_DDzqu81V4pclA1u-FVv0ZEssp5Z8I1h-tZLq4SgQr1yHd-sB-iSqt-iwjlnXxBmVoT62g3kHU-07vSl8e6DjGqxzyHofyaGeVQjTBL530cpJeDvHAkK-us6FXvXkNlQRLnqSiSagzqfvcGoj2XRPmR7dmWcukcqP87Ocf_8V_iO8AobdcsrqQlntLtmYmwy2vqKh4hyjUj2GioAPGiBfvvN9doL9EMxJofFU2T77vPRlm2pDNB7G_Ye-6s1-5XEvzunY1rVBiC1CgMMZNpnaEX9phNO1oylbxigilMwVCG7gNhP98JUptI_rGLG-AfvyOUb2nrf4KMqF-6_sdaoNDi_L11QeOdk4Jam "That's why I’m teaming up with Majority Leader Steve Scalise to raise a million dollars by the end of the month to get our message out to the people, register voters in key states, and turn them out to VOTE REPUBLICAN up and down the ballot.")**_

Peter, I grew up across the street from one of Donald Trump's golf courses in New York. This one, in fact: ↘↘ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87571058/481557076/-933762732?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20240625_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZDg0MTNmNy0wYjMzLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kdyiElHSnAOa_j1hDR4fd0QrcBm0X7jHgkQzy6CTZ7M=) Yes, really. But it was not the way I think you're picturing it in your mind — let me explain.

I didn't live in a skyrise apartment or a mansion with luxuries at my fingertips.

**I grew up in the Throggs Neck Houses, a crumbling public housing project among vermin, lead, and mold, across from Trump's Golf Course in The Bronx.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87571059/481557077/-933762732?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20240625_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZDg0MTNmNy0wYjMzLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kdyiElHSnAOa_j1hDR4fd0QrcBm0X7jHgkQzy6CTZ7M=) My mom was a single mom, working multiple jobs to keep food on the table. I'm so grateful for how much she sacrificed to provide for our family.

Living across from Trump's Golf Course, I had to see a reminder every day of how easily and often our government supports and enables the ultra-wealthy at the expense of working families.

You see, the New York City government shoveled over _$100 million in government aid_ to develop this golf course with Donald Trump and the corrupt Trump Organization. _They did this while New York families like mine lived in hunger and poverty across the street._

But, I always try to look at the positives — growing up smelling the stench of Donald Trump (even before he became president) has led me to where I am today: **Fighting in Congress for justice for real working families.**

When I work on legislation, I always think about the families who are struggling just like mine did. I lived that experience — it is not abstract to me. And I'll never forget it.

I hope you feel like you have a better sense of who I am and what my values are. I swear that I'm fighting for those values every day in Congress.

Right now, the shadow of Trump and his MAGA cult looms large. They're determined to strip our right to vote, give tax breaks to people like Trump, and put special interests ahead of working families _– and they’re raising millions to pull it off._

I'm so grateful for how much she sacrificed to provide for our family. Living across from Trump's Golf Course, I had to see a reminder every day of how easily and often our government supports and enables the ultra-wealthy at the expense of working families. You see, the New York City government shoveled over $100 million in government aid to develop this golf course with Donald Trump and the corrupt Trump Organization. They did this while New York families like mine lived in hunger and poverty across the street. But, I always try to look at the positives — growing up smelling the stench of Donald Trump (even before he became president) has led me to where I am today: Fighting in Congress for justice for real working families. When I work on legislation, I always think about the families who are struggling just like mine did. I lived that experience — it is not abstract to me. And I'll never forget it. I hope you feel like you have a better sense of who I am and what my values are. I swear that I'm fighting for those values every day in Congress. name: John Avlon
subject: This Is It - Election Day is Today!
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JOHN AVLON FOR CONGRESS
body:
https://x.com/JohnAvlon/status/1805609244512993803 [https://x.com/JohnAvlon/status/1805609244512993803]

Friends,

125 days ago - barely four months ago - I decided to enter the arena.

And now today, across Suffolk County, voters are making their voices heard. On Election Day, I’m reminded of what I said the day I announced, because it’s rung true each and every day on the trail:

“We need to build the broadest possible coalition to defend our democracy, defeat Donald Trump, and win back the House from his MAGA minions. I know that if we work together, we can flip this seat and finally solve problems for Long Island families... Our next member of Congress needs to work with all people of good faith, based on common sense and common facts to solve the common problems we face. We need someone who will put Suffolk County’s values first – not Donald Trump’s.”

I’ve been inspired by the energy and enthusiasm - and unprecedented number of primary endorsements that have come in - all because Democrats across the district are hungry for a win.

For a long time, people thought this district was fading away – but I believed that’s just generals fighting the last war. We saw next door with Tom Suozzi how candidate quality matters so much – and how playing offense on the issues people care about and seizing the center matters. Common sense and common facts are winners here for Suffolk county families.

From abortion to affordability, it all comes back to the same thing: we have to win to actually make the change we need. And it’s no coincidence that we've seen the middle of our politics hollowed out at the same time we've seen the middle of our economy hollowed out. Voters here want someone who they know can go to Washington and fight for their rights and fight to rebuild the middle class. The hunger for a win is a hunger for actually getting things done.

As I said on Morning Joe this morning, my closing argument is exactly what I’ve been telling voters since we started this journey together. We need to win. Six of the eight Democratic town committees, local Democratic leaders like Tom Suozzi and Fred Thiele, 5 labor unions and national Democrats all know we can’t afford to lose this fight. I’m the only Democrat who can win the general election - which is why my opponent’s own union has endorsed me.

https://x.com/JohnAvlon/status/1805609244512993803 [https://x.com/JohnAvlon/status/1805609244512993803]

If you can do one last thing this Election Day, please share this clip and remind people in the 1st District they need to get out and vote today so we can go win the general election.

I am going to keep this short - we are spending the day convincing even more voters to come out and vote for me (and yes, there are still undecideds on Election Day!) and turning out our own vote.

I just wanted to thank you all for being happy warriors in this good fight with me. Who would have thought that yes, running a campaign on West Wing-style ideals could evolve into such a powerful force.

Your support has meant so much to me. We couldn’t have put ourselves in such a strong position over the last 125 days without you. Is it possible to be both humbled and proud? I am today.

Thank you again - let’s go win this!

- John

PAID FOR BY JOHN AVLON FOR CONGRESS

John Avlon for Congress
PO Box 1200
Sag Harbor, NY 11963
United States

I want to take a moment to remind you of my journey to the U.S. Senate, the important le ssons I have learned along the way, and why I continue to believe wholeheartedly in our beloved state.

My father, a World War II veteran, left school during the Great Depression to join the Army. Though he only had a ninth grade education, he built a career as a hard-working cement finisher. My mother, a dedicated voter who never missed an election, instilled in me the importance of civic duty.

From my parents, I inherited an unwavering love for this country that I have proudly carried throughout my life. It's something I strive to keep alive in Wyoming.

Later, in medical school, I learned the importance of having a plan before taking action, a lesson that has proven invaluable in both my medical career and my service as your senator. Just as in surgery, effective leadership requires a clear vision and a strategic approach to problem-solving.

As you may know, I am sometimes referred to as _"Wyoming's doctor,"_ but to be honest, that is what I have always strived to be as your senator. I have wholeheartedly dedicated myself to serving the state, addressing its challenges, and making it the best it can be.

**_Whether it's advocating for our veterans, championing American energy security, or safeguarding our borders, I've always strived to be a voice for all Wyoming people. Your concerns are my concerns, and your aspirations are my aspirations._**

As we look towards the future, I'm confident that Wyoming has the potential to be an even stronger, more prosperous state. **[But it will require strong leadership, a clear vision, and your continued support.](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=bdc58176656d40638bc6ea3cb98694a8&_e=oAYS6ySq49zXPAWM1WWNDxIjcoEQG1uusBYQE4GYpSNCziew0Q4QluyZBHbw0-aE2HQJHxMFpBbI3_mHtxMDQXJL9zZ77Qqjd3XlpwxTGtZLybgurBK-OPwrMLK-p-86SpwH4WdJa6QRu8PTngZKkb8c65_X55mcvtMUzkVrg74riZVbK191YFQ51SR0Xtg8e7DDnrWwSStGMjyaLRnv6n7HcTgknrBk8PhRDcw-9xnK1aop8vQi-_UhAyaE4OpIKgB73EKYzgqXP3hQi1kOsQ%3D%3D)**

Already, your support has been instrumental in my journey, and I promise to continue fighting for the issues that matter most to Wyoming families.

Sincerely,
Senator John Barrasso [CHIP IN FOR A STRONG WYOMING](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=bdc58176656d40638bc6ea3cb98694a8&_e=oAYS6ySq49zXPAWM1WWNDxIjcoEQG1uusBYQE4GYpSNCziew0Q4QluyZBHbw0-aE2HQJHxMFpBbI3_mHtxMDQXJL9zZ77Qqjd3XlpwxTGtZLybgurBK-OPwrMLK-p-86lciDFUAecVzmrMo2gzw0ac68N6R2DbR1W9snMHuGPeqI-37_JQjfJ8Kr4ERBgrXwQUOH61E2txysAwZ57z94Q6jjl0su7s_bP7LtI1lxHuvISIrBf9rqg-9R7qcmv-ISh4uQYa5k9Svckt6kVE_F3VynmppjsYzPAIht_HSkrig%3D)

My family’s story is the American Dream. Both of my grandfathers were sons of immigrants who grew up poor. Despite not having much, when they returned from World War II they were able to find good jobs. With those jobs, they bought homes, started families, and earned their way into the middle class.

Peter —

Yesterday was the two-year anniversary of SCOTUS’s decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade_.

Nationwide, women and girls were stripped of a fundamental right to make our own healthcare decisions. It was, and still is, terrifying – and the GOP celebrates it as a victory.

**But remember – we are not powerless.**

In the two years since that decision, Republicans have repeatedly attempted to further erode reproductive rights and our bodily autonomy.

_And yet, despite these significant challenges, time and time again, we’ve seen choice win on the ballot._

Our voice is our power. Our vote is our power. And we must use them – to defend seats; to flip seats; to elect Democrats up and down the ballot who will defend our rights; to take back the House. That’s what this campaign is all about.

**And to do that, we’ve set a goal of raising an additional $16,000 to show strength on our public filing, to deliver a blue wave to PA and the Philly suburbs this November, and to fight for women’s rights.** **[If you’re able, please consider donating $10, $25, or whatever you can to our fight today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87574658/481568486/-1799742017?amount=25&refcode=06252024_md_EOQ_fr_1&refcode2=48841f29-1033-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ODg0MWYyOS0xMDMzLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Z-NcZLfl24uFqn9nSA77bUIRpEg4dWC_4-UcLGUkqmM=)** | | [ **DONATE** ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87574668/481568489/-1799742017?amount=25&refcode=06252024_md_EOQ_fr_1&refcode2=48841f29-1033-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ODg0MWYyOS0xMDMzLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Z-NcZLfl24uFqn9nSA77bUIRpEg4dWC_4-UcLGUkqmM=)

The recent blocked vote to protect contraceptive access; attacks on IVF; women fleeing their home states to get lifesaving care; and teen girls being forced to share their reproductive history to play sports — stories like these courtesy of the GOP underscore the dire, dangerous nature of this moment.

We must fight back – and I’m committed to doing my part to make sure we win big this November. Our daughters and granddaughters deserve a future where their voices are heard, their rights are protected, and their bodies are their own.

**[Only if you’re able, please donate today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87574679/481568501/-1799742017?amount=25&refcode=06252024_md_EOQ_fr_1&refcode2=48841f29-1033-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ODg0MWYyOS0xMDMzLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Z-NcZLfl24uFqn9nSA77bUIRpEg4dWC_4-UcLGUkqmM=)**

With my thanks,

Madeleine

name: Andrew Hughes
subject: Are you fed up with cancel culture?
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| |
---
| | | [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)
---
| Fellow Patriot,

Dr. Carson asked me to reach out to Americans who want what's best for our country, to help him take a stand against "cancel culture." It's tearing our country apart and needs to be stopped.

This is something he has experienced firsthand.

As you may have heard, this past November the Detroit School Board voted to change the name of the Benjamin Carson High School of Science and Medicine. Why? Because the School Board was mad that Dr. Carson was part of the Trump Administration!

These educational leaders - who should be acting as role models for our kids - instead decided to create a huge political spectacle by "canceling" Dr. Carson and trying to erase his amazing achievements as a doctor, as a leader, and as a citizen. It's really outrageous.

Dr. Carson is disappointed by this - not because he wants any glory but because it sets a bad example ... for the kids at this school, and for the entire country.

"Cancel culture" tells young people and all Americans that you shouldn't listen to those with whom you disagree and try to find common ground; you should just stigmatize them and erase them.

The Left probably expected Dr. Carson to lash out at the Detroit School Board and his political opponents - hurl some insults, call people names, keep the fight going.

But instead, Dr. Carson said to our team here at the American Cornerstone Institute (ACI):

_" What if we use this as an opportunity to rally people across the country to speak out against cancel culture? To show America that we have a better path forward for our country than hate and division?"_

And that's exactly what we're doing. It's why Dr. Carson launched ACI in the first place - to lead the way for what's best for our country.

And we've created a way for you to stand with Dr. Carson and make your voice heard. Just click the link below; it will take you to our **National Statement Against Cancel Culture** that you can review and then co-sign.

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/cancel-culture-pledge](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)

Dr. Carson is getting asked about the Detroit school incident quite a bit, and when he answers he wants to speak for Americans who are heartbroken by what cancel culture is doing to our country - who want this divisiveness and vitriol to end! I think you're just such an American.

And when you and thousands of concerned citizens like you sign this Statement, Dr. Carson will be able to keep speaking from the heart against cancel culture - knowing that he's broadcasting a message that is important to his fellow Americans.

He can say ... "Enough is enough! I'm fed up with cancel culture, and so are folks everywhere who love America and want what's best for the country."

If that's a message you want Dr. Carson to share on your behalf, please take a moment now to be part of ACI's **National Statement Against Cancel Culture**. Here's the link again for you:

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/cancel-culture-pledge](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.-klNVNpSN4VYHSw)

Amid all the divisiveness and polarization that has been injected into our policy debates, Dr. Carson is proud of the work ACI is doing to encourage Americans to come together despite our differences and find ways to take on the challenges that face our country.

I hope you'll join Dr. Carson in this important work. Thank you!

Sincerely,

Andrew D. Hughes
Executive Director & CEO
American Cornerstone Institute

| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE TUESDAY, JUNE 25
GREATER GEORGIA LAUNCHES NEW AD CAMPAIGN AHEAD OF FIRST PRESIDENTIAL DEBATE
(ATLANTA) - Today, Greater Georgia Action released a new digital ad campaign ahead of the first presidential debate of 2024 in Atlanta. The 30-second spot, entitled "[Promises](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001nEweqo4m2DTydhOTXmZOeTDx5NBTBtP3FCYav3w1CWNFP5OJUqZkqnvlEej_8vI2Kvpvxad-TFRN32cibXV57simZfZTWa5ZgnijfMjxb8OOWZflB4qEYwt7SSZvYR2_KQmkjkMdazwWwN-pKVoSDB2Vl75-6pzG&c=tXO3wcvbUUF8aeS93T232HVmY89864J54ouUAbfkLnHNuDLPl_JyWg==&ch=wqVAgWm0eF3c_sHeH2oAvjtkmijD_1spqU6ZQba_kBCbBDgztzw_1w==)," highlights the Biden Administration's broken promises, particularly to Black voters. This is in contrast to the promise of the American Dream, which former President Donald Trump's Administration delivered for all communities, especially working families - reducing Black unemployment and poverty levels to [record lows](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001nEweqo4m2DTydhOTXmZOeTDx5NBTBtP3FCYav3w1CWNFP5OJUqZkqnvlEej_8vI2KTIIwujT1QEi0ijVLhj9B9ZcgR_bYmdxc-BBnb94N0KvChjVyYaTitQ-CTgJUiNM2uHm75k6hWS6z0K6F28SF_qOv1jVZSyuhIUsztv50j2aCOqQGuNA30wvLjisoeBBQLA0ebVdezoyEKLE8sbHrxcDR39Efcy7R4n3gPBQFysGfJqP2KlrR9Qy3jeaLumArcDP3ahA-ioDUNpoVKuWRU1z4uu9UWGRaR8vD4Vew_YLQOx1x1HouBpsUn6O1Gb8lGPyNQZ9m_qbW0mNYMgwYg==&c=tXO3wcvbUUF8aeS93T232HVmY89864J54ouUAbfkLnHNuDLPl_JyWg==&ch=wqVAgWm0eF3c_sHeH2oAvjtkmijD_1spqU6ZQba_kBCbBDgztzw_1w==). The ad campaign will reach voters on streaming services and digital platforms within the Atlanta DMA and will run during the week of the debate.
According to polls, Americans largely believe the country is on the [wrong track](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001nEweqo4m2DTydhOTXmZOeTDx5NBTBtP3FCYav3w1CWNFP5OJUqZkqnvlEej_8vI2LEKcTe9VZ5HAEQuSk-d2y7wdYSrcPAwZL19wdOQ6eYHueIoxPKCY3E3AJOJXDD7w1RRedtaF0rjOCKQbu-zo2JAVlt38pLd6-VP2612CCLzthS7srctZwemDQga3ygnRvJLtiArR2jSHB3aUJeCq18OrNFWM3R5iuA3es_VVZDGtAtezgEO2zPHH4X6ckQMSa8L3NeokOPS8Ne3CA35Q0Jac_F7j09Qu&c=tXO3wcvbUUF8aeS93T232HVmY89864J54ouUAbfkLnHNuDLPl_JyWg==&ch=wqVAgWm0eF3c_sHeH2oAvjtkmijD_1spqU6ZQba_kBCbBDgztzw_1w==). Black voters are increasingly reporting a sense of loss of economic and personal security. Besides overseeing an era of peace and low crime, under President Trump, the average annual household income [rose](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001nEweqo4m2DTydhOTXmZOeTDx5NBTBtP3FCYav3w1CWNFP5OJUqZkqnvlEej_8vI22wMT-tcvs1Rf3YzQDklgkLZTZlghD6ZqKs2RwYkFHFspQFtrFcXPGbtPdpyYn3FRGoXUa0IS_YY4ud0iQS5hr3Xi9uNwWNynTbWiMkPiHjD22EEHCxFw4PhltCoN7A015b2rGIKhhOWiuTvPpE6pAeBqhdn-CcJzMhssRr8zaW5qItbBqcfhWeXZyq0C4qKWmUoOULSOTT4=&c=tXO3wcvbUUF8aeS93T232HVmY89864J54ouUAbfkLnHNuDLPl_JyWg==&ch=wqVAgWm0eF3c_sHeH2oAvjtkmijD_1spqU6ZQba_kBCbBDgztzw_1w==) over $5,000 while inflation remained low. Under President Biden, amid wars and rising crime, average household [costs](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001nEweqo4m2DTydhOTXmZOeTDx5NBTBtP3FCYav3w1CWNFP5OJUqZkqnvlEej_8vI2j7BRHaVHYtCB_e3DNfLb6i4M4BZqXWDFEwNQU56FIAPWf7mK4bMygfbLzBmewGDL-KHahvEpauJctz5AHWPBktjk0-_yJYEHvY206uQbMZfCQ0v0ar2egNyaOno1SKvBjrSf1mdavuA=&c=tXO3wcvbUUF8aeS93T232HVmY89864J54ouUAbfkLnHNuDLPl_JyWg==&ch=wqVAgWm0eF3c_sHeH2oAvjtkmijD_1spqU6ZQba_kBCbBDgztzw_1w==) to maintain the same standard of living are up over $12,000 per year, with income gains well below the pace of inflation.
"It's no wonder Americans feel less secure and hopeful. After years of record inflation, illegal immigration, and weakness on the world stage, voters have lost faith in the Left's empty promises - especially voters in diverse communities, who are rejecting the premise that they must vote Democrat when these same officials fail them," said Greater Georgia Chairwoman and former U.S. Senator Kelly Loeffler. "All Americans understand that the path to prosperity lies in individual freedom, the opportunities offered by free enterprise, and the safety and security families deserve - rather than the pandering and falsehoods Joe Biden is rehearsing for Thursday night. Instead of the promise of more big government, Donald Trump stands for the promise of America's strength and prosperity - which is the only promise worth believing this November."

name: State Representative Ryan Chamberlin
subject: Weekly Update from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/official-newsletter-12699093?e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| |
---
| | **WEEKLY UPDATE FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN**
---
| My Fellow Floridians,

I consider it a great honor to serve **Florida** and represent **House District 24** in our state legislature. Last week, I had the opportunity to spend some time traveling across the state and community to meet with constituents and fellow leaders. In the **Florida House** , I’m working hard alongside **Governor Ron DeSantis** and my conservative colleagues to combat the insanity of the radical Left and keep our state the **Free State of Florida**.

I’m very grateful for your continued support as I serve as your **State Representative**. I have been working diligently to fight inflation, champion smart growth, and keep taxes and property insurance low. This is just the beginning of my work for the **Sunshine State** , and I look forward to continuing my good work for Floridians in the upcoming legislative session.

Please do not hesitate to reach out to my office if you need assistance by clicking **[here](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=5adf19a645&e=d1c1b9864f)**. My staff and I would be happy to assist you in any way we can! We want to work alongside you to address the issues important to our community.
---
| | **Monday, June 17 - Faith and Freedom CoMission**
---
|
---
| I had the opportunity to speak to the **Faith and Freedom CoMission** about this past legislative session and the upcoming amendments we will be voting on in November. It is always great to be able to speak to a great group of **America-first Floridians** who are working hard to promote faith and freedom in Florida. Thank you to **Father Don** for inviting me to speak.
---
| | **Tuesday, June 18 - Florida Chamber Political Institute Tallahassee Legislative Reception**
---
|
---
|
---
---
| I had the privilege of attending the **Florida Chamber Political Institute Tallahassee Legislative Reception**. It was an honor to support our business ideals and free enterprise in Florida. I will always fight for our small businesses and pro-business policies in the **Florida Legislature**. That’s how we’ll keep Florida free and prosperous for many years to come.
---
| | **Legislation Signed into Law by Governor Ron DeSantis**
---
|
---
| Last week, **Governor Ron DeSantis** signed several important pieces of legislation into law that will help many Floridians thrive, including our veterans and their families. Please see the signed bills below:
* [CS/CS/HB 885 – Coverage for Biomarker Testing](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=717a5a96e1&e=d1c1b9864f)
* [CS/CS/CS/SB 1582 – Department of Health](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=3864b251fe&e=d1c1b9864f)
* [CS/SB 7072 – Cancer Funding](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=211f810736&e=d1c1b9864f)
* [SB 7078 – Public Records](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=45d0105f76&e=d1c1b9864f)
* [HB 725 – Veterans’ Long-term Care Facilities Admissions](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=95658dc41e&e=d1c1b9864f)
* [CS/CS/HB 1329 – Veterans](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=1cda2bd9d4&e=d1c1b9864f)

If you have any questions about the bills signed by **Governor DeSantis** , please do not hesitate to contact my office by clicking **[here](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=d8ec838cb9&e=d1c1b9864f)**. We would be happy to speak with you!
---
|
---
| | Thank you for electing me to serve you in our state legislature! It has been an incredible honor to serve you and help build a brighter future for **Florida** and **House District 24**. I look forward to the progress we will make for our state in the future.

Have a great week! I look forward to sharing with you again soon.

Best regards,

**Ryan Chamberlin**
******State Representative**
**District 24**
---

State Representative Ryan Chamberlin

1101 The Capitol
402 South Monroe Street
Tallahassee, FL 32399-1300

#### After her unexpected win, the perennial candidate has to answer for some odd choices and legal lapses in her campaign.
---
| Erin McClelland's win over Ryan Bizzarro, despite her previous campaign losses and lack of major endorsements, was a big surprise in the Democratic primary for state treasurer.

However, McClelland faces scrutiny over campaign finance issues and her controversial choice of campaign staff, including disbarred former legislator Jesse White. As she prepares to face Republican incumbent Stacy Garrity, questions about her campaign practices and qualifications remain.

## About Salena Zito:
---
| |
---
Salena Zito, a veteran political reporter with 20+ years of award-winning experience in print and broadcast journalism, is known for her unique approach to reporting. Traveling over 400,000 miles in her Jeep, she avoids interstates to listen to everyday Americans far from Manhattan and the Beltway. Zito foresaw the 2016 election outcome, noting the media's misjudgment of Donald Trump. She serves as a national political reporter for the _Washington Examiner_ and as a contributor to the _Wall Street Journal_. Her bestseller, "The Great Revolt," received bipartisan praise for its insights into American politics. Zito has won numerous awards, including the prestigious Clarion Award three times.

| Texans for Vaccine Choice has been working on the issue of childcare facilities illegally denying vaccine exemptions for enrollment for [several years](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0yNTEwMzg0Mjk3NjcyNzEwNTQ3JmM9aThvNCZlPTAmYj0xMzM1MTU0MDk4JmQ9bDB2MGcwdg==.6WIaTF9fsLsW5jujT9S0qAyeWDtuQ7B0qy5vBOaMylI). Despite the linked article’s byline saying we were “misinterpreting the law,” TFVC’s relentless pursuit of correct application of statute finally proved victorious. **After TFVC left no stone unturned, Texas HHSC, the state agency that regulates these facilities, issued an**[**Operation Action Letter**](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0yNTEwMzg0Mjk3NjcyNzEwNTQ3JmM9aThvNCZlPTAmYj0xMzM1MTU0MTAwJmQ9cjl1MnUwZw==.08vngi9yxab2OysxAAAsiGIi1JojsPcOCMwP-vBAVGk)**last summer, admitting to a “previous misapplication of the statute.”** While thrilled that HHSC finally agreed that, [by law](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0yNTEwMzg0Mjk3NjcyNzEwNTQ3JmM9aThvNCZlPTAmYj0xMzM1MTU0MTAzJmQ9czlmMnM3aQ==.33Fn5RJC8ad93RIueveVXUsGr7D4deQEsqDnRglD7Uc), all licensed childcare centers in Texas must accept vaccine exemptions, a year later, TFVC continues to receive reports that some facilities continue to deny them. If you come across this issue, first ensure the facility is licensed by searching the database [HERE](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0yNTEwMzg0Mjk3NjcyNzEwNTQ3JmM9aThvNCZlPTAmYj0xMzM1MTU0MTA3JmQ9cThmNXYyeg==.pBkLYgjshUlhOUlPVqBfeex0ZS-vo-Gk4QXXmsH9qdA). Then, if after providing the licensed facility the [Operation Action Letter](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0yNTEwMzg0Mjk3NjcyNzEwNTQ3JmM9aThvNCZlPTAmYj0xMzM1MTU0MTEzJmQ9bTB5N3Awaw==.EnHhY7kMVKA4glwleAeBgT1s_tyGD3SNgxjFAgvVV8Q), they persist in denying enrollment, you can consider filing a complaint by calling a licensing representative at [512-834-3426](tel:512-834-3426) or by [contacting TFVC](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0yNTEwMzg0Mjk3NjcyNzEwNTQ3JmM9aThvNCZlPTAmYj0xMzM1MTU0MTE5JmQ9dDB0OHE1dA==.5wZTf7Bv0P1lPrQFV33LZr-38_1aT_UjMccNieDidQc). **Together, we will continue to protect parental rights and hold institutions accountable to the law!****
**

Hey there, can I share something with you?
When I came out in college, I knew I was interested in a career in public service. But I feared that I would have to face a serious choice between pursuing the field of my dreams or living my authentic life openly.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87585118/481600143/-2013249406?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4079-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNDIwZGIxZi0xZTMzLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NG2EskFtRFKGpY9Q5NsYD-zEzrZD-uaA0wZpm4WL8yE=)
After seeing others in the LGBTQ+ community demonstrate acts of courage by coming out, being themselves, and being public about who they are and who they love, I came to realize that I could do both:
**I could run for office and be honest about who I am — so that’s exactly what I did.**
When I became the first openly gay Senator elected in our nation’s history, I understood that I needed to use this extraordinary opportunity to make a difference in people's lives. From lowering prescription drug prices to protecting same-sex marriage through the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , I’ve worked hard every day since to do just that.
That's why I ran for office in the first place — not to make history, but to make a difference. And folks like you supported me because you wanted to make a difference, too.

Peter,

Two years ago this week, the Supreme Court upended nearly 50 years of precedent by overturning _Roe v. Wade_ – the landmark case that guaranteed a woman's right to choose.

Since then, we've seen one state after another enact laws that curtail or completely ban abortion, and one – Alabama – that even banned in vitro fertilization, denying millions of women the opportunity to become pregnant. Fourteen states have entirely banned abortion and many more have enacted bans as early as six weeks gestation.

What do all of these have in common? Taking personal healthcare decisions away from women and handing them to the government. **That's outrageous.**

Here's what I believe: **healthcare is a right.** And that includes reproductive healthcare.

This isn't the government's business. **Only you should decide how you plan your family** – not politicians in Washington, DC. For many women, these are critical life-or-death decisions. It's time we treat these choices – and women – with the respect and dignity they deserve.

As one of just two pro-choice women doctors in Congress, I will continue to fight for women's reproductive care and to make _Roe_ the law of the land.

But, Peter, we can only do that with a pro-choice majority in the House.

I’m the America First conservative and political outsider running to defeat 50-year career politician Shady Sherrod Brown in Ohio’s toss-up U.S. Senate race. President Donald Trump won Ohio in 2016 and 2020 , making it one of our best chances to flip a seat red in 2024. Democrats have a 2-seat majority, which means we MUST flip Ohio in order to restore a Republican majority that can work with a Trump White House to get our country back on track. President Trump has endorsed my campaign , and it’s been my privilege to campaign alongside him. The latest polls show Brown with a 5% lead , just outside the margin of error. Brown is also leading ALL U.S. SENATE CANDIDATES in fundraising, making ours one of the biggest challenges to overcome. I hope you understand we have no choice but to win this seat in Ohio. But I’m behind – both in polling and fundraising. I can’t win in Ohio unless I receive the same support (or more) from you and our conservative grassroots base that Sherrod Brown is from his leftist base. Thankfully, we still have time to catch up. But it’s going to take all of us pulling together! Please show your commitment to delivering a Republican Senate majority for President Trump in 2024 by following his lead and sending support to our campaign. Thank you for stepping up, Bernie Moreno GOP Nominee for Senate, Ohio Meet Bernie Moreno: | Bernie Moreno fights for the American Dream because he’s lived it. Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American Dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18. Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America. In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board. After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation. Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First. Ohioans are done with politicians who talk a big game and do nothing. Bernie wants to go to D.C. to get work done – just like he always has. subject: re: My coming out story

body:
#
Hi there, can I share something with you?
When I came out in college, I knew I was interested in a career in public service. But I feared that I would have to face a serious choice between pursuing the field of my dreams or living my authentic life openly.
[](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-baldwin-split.kt1qkh&refcode=em240625-2-nor-exp&t=1&akid=5341%2E196590%2EHank3C)
After seeing others in the LGBTQ+ community demonstrate acts of courage by coming out, being themselves, and being public about who they are and who they love, I came to realize that I could do both:
**I could run for office and be honest about who I am — so that’s exactly what I did.**
When I became the first openly gay Senator elected in our nation’s history, I understood that I needed to use this extraordinary opportunity to make a difference in people's lives. From lowering prescription drug prices to protecting same-sex marriage through the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , I’ve worked hard every day since to do just that.
That's why I ran for office in the first place — not to make history, but to make a difference. And folks like you supported me because you wanted to make a difference, too.
[**I’m facing my most competitive and expensive reelection yet, so I can’t keep up this work without your help. Will you help me continue to make a difference by splitting a donation between The Long Run and my reelection campaign today?**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-baldwin-split.kt1qkh&refcode=em240625-2-nor-exp&t=2&akid=5341%2E196590%2EHank3C)

---
****
We have made incredible progress over the years in the fight for equality — but folks, we cannot mistake that progress for a total victory.
Republican-led state legislatures across the country continue to pass harmful legislation, especially targeting the transgender community and LGBTQ+ youth. **In 2024 alone, 515 anti-LGBTQ+ bills have been introduced across the country.**
It’s going to take all of us to counter these right wing attacks so everyone grows up knowing they belong, and that kindness and inclusion — not hatred and division — are American values.
[**This Pride Month, I’m hoping you’ll support this important work by splitting a donation between The Long Run and my reelection campaign to send me back to the United States Senate.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-baldwin-split.kt1qkh&refcode=em240625-2-nor-exp&t=27&akid=5341%2E196590%2EHank3C)

Thank you for your ongoing support. Let’s recommit ourselves to work towards the day when all LGBTQ+ Americans can live in a world where they feel safe, accepted, and loved.
Happy Pride! 🏳️🌈
— Tammy

Fellow American,

I am not the typical Republican running for United States Senate.

** ➡️ I am a small business owner, who built my business brick by brick.**

** ➡️ I am a lifelong Republican.**

** ➡️ I am pro-parent. **

** ➡️ I support Israel.**

---
| | | The first presidential debate is just days away, and it looks like Donald Trump may chicken out after all. Trump fluffers such as Steve Bannon and Ronnie Jackson are now coming up with [all kinds of excuses](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tceb483f9-dca5-4d8e-919a-664099f49348/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) why Trump should skip them, and even Trump himself is starting to [hint](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3415804f-6af8-4a20-a108-a14252b163a3/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) that he will bow out. The Trump campaign appears to have realized they've made a terrible mistake in letting Trump and his pickled brain go on stage and actually be forced to answer questions without a crowd of supporters to whoop and cheer for whatever nonsense he spews (there will be no audience). They fear he will look like a complete idiot -- and sometimes looks are not deceiving. And they are trying to undo the damage before it happens. [**Don't let them get away with it. Add your name, and demand that Trump not chicken out of the debate.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T91eaa5bb-6194-4897-87e0-243563727b13/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Modern medicine has been treating knee pain with "solutions" that don't solve the problem for most folks... That's why some medical practitioners **HATE** studies like these and why you haven't heard about it... If you care about abortion rights, [**then you must care about Pennsylvania.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2267?t=8&akid=2240%2E4032634%2E62pQK9) If you care about the future of our democracy, [**then you must care about Pennsylvania.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2267?t=9&akid=2240%2E4032634%2E62pQK9) If you care about making our economy work for working people, [**then you must care about Pennsylvania.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2267?t=10&akid=2240%2E4032634%2E62pQK9) Pennsylvania’s Senate race this year could very well decide control of the chamber — and whether or not Republicans have the votes to pass more abortion restrictions, allow more tax cuts for corporations, and enable other extremist policies. Right now Bob Casey is running against an anti-abortion hedge fund millionaire, Dave McCormick, with a Super PAC spending millions in advertising for him. Pennsylvania could also decide the Presidency. And we know when campaigns have the resources to turn out voters up and down the ballot, it makes a huge impact. Donald Trump also knows this. He’s visited the state five times already this year to rally his MAGA base for himself and McCormick. Democrats can fight back and win this critical swing state — but to do that, Bob Casey needs this team's support right now, especially ahead of Sunday's powerfully important fundraising reporting deadline. [**So I’m asking if you can split a donation between Bob Casey’s campaign in Pennsylvania and our re-election campaign right now. I’m going to keep fighting hard to protect our Senate majority and pass national abortion protections, and that can’t happen if we lose Pennsylvania.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2267?t=11&akid=2240%2E4032634%2E62pQK9)

(Dr. Goldstein presenting to FCCBN - June 24, 2024)
Thanks for reading Michael's Substack! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work.
[Pledge your support](https://substack..IyZY_154rXdgnNhNEdoHTSyOy4ZUzXpjZwTMnlVZZhg?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=145988183)
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1454853&post_id=145988183&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ1OTg4MTgzLCJpYXQiOjE3MTkzNDk0MTksImV4cCI6MTcyMTk0MTQxOSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTE0NTQ4NTMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.KA5hI5mjeC8ce0mE3eiJ2EWj3I9yWaNnK30wj3q6bDI)
_I recently spoke to the[Fairfield County Commercial Brokers Network](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/30637e0c-2e56-4773-b2e7-5e45b0697312?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). _It is a networking organization that connects commercial real estate brokers and affiliated businesses in the commercial real estate space. This is a group that has been around for over 25 years that was started by Winthrop E. Baum. [FCCBN ](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/30637e0c-2e56-4773-b2e7-5e45b0697312?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)has been incredible at making commercial deals happen while serving clients and the community at large.
The commercial market clearly has seen some challenges. Connecticut is no longer a manufacturing state and it could become one once again. This, after all, was the state that put man on the moon. With the right political leadership at the state and federal level, Connecticut can return to its roots as a manufacturing and high technology manufacturing state.
Unlike the residential market, the commercial real estate market is largely dependent on local business activity. In Fairfield County, the residential market is still hot as people are leaving New York City for a host of quality of life reasons, including personal safety, quality public schools, lower taxes, open space, increased anti-Semitism and the ability to telecommute full or part time. People who come here share their positive experience with their friends and colleagues and that attracts even more New Yorkers.
Despite the fact that Connecticut has one of the best educated and healthiest workforce, the commercial real estate market depends on office buildings being filled with workers and growth in the manufacturing sector. Demand is reduced by telecommuting, high energy costs and the anticompetitive actions of the Connecticut state and local governments.
Bringing more jobs to Connecticut requires a new and pro-business strategy including: reduced regulatory burdens, expedited zoning and permit approvals, improving the infrastructure with less congested highways and improved commuter rail service. Tax incentives and opportunity zones are tools that can be used to attract new businesses to our beautiful state. These are techniques being used by other states to lure away Connecticut businesses. **We need to be more aggressive in both attracting and keeping businesses here.**
My Congressional candidacy is focused on a collaboration between the federal and local governments to solve these problems.
**Transportation**
In my understanding, the federal government can fund up to 80% of the cost of expanding I-95. For the many of us who drive this road during rush hour, the traffic congestion has only gotten worse since Jim Himes became our congressman in 2009. Yet, he has not taken any substantial action to solve the problem.
I plan to make every effort to secure the funds necessary to expand I-95 and improve the quality of life for every driver who uses that road. In the short run to alleviate the immediate need of congestion in the I-95 corridor, I would seek funding to put in movable barriers like they have in every other state. This is an inexpensive and standard practice to reduce congestion and improve traffic flow.
As for rail transportation, our Metro North system is plagued with many areas where the trains do not move at high speeds due to aging track, and antiquated rail bridges. Currently, rail service is designed to commute to New York City. Smaller trains could be used on the same tracks for commuting between towns in Connecticut such as the expansion of the New Canaan and other spur lines.
We should be attracting the businesses who employ the former New Yorkers who have moved to Connecticut to either relocate or create satellite offices here. This would reduce commuting, bring income and corporate tax revenue into Connecticut and allow those businesses to reduce the costs.
In addition, as a Congressman, I would also work on expanding regional airports which makes traveling easier for Connecticut residents and would benefit the industries that rely on air shipping. They might be able to avoid clogging our roads as they transport air freight to New York City, Hartford and Boston airports.
**Energy Costs and Energy Availability**
Manufacturing, depending on the specific industry, depends on varying degrees of energy costs. Connecticut has some of the highest energy generation, transmission and green energy costs of any state in the continental United States. Senator Ryan Fazio has been a champion to challenge energy issues in Connecticut. He is one of the few lone soldiers in this fight.
The main reason for high energy costs in Connecticut is that we natural gas and nuclear power to generate our electricity. Thanks to federal laws that deny us access to inexpensive U.S. natural gas forces Connecticut to import more expensive natural gas. We are also dependent on antiquated and aging out nuclear power generation plants. This is a crisis in the making.
If elected, I would fight to repeal the laws to make natural gas transmission to Connecticut easier through additional pipelines while facilitating the transportation of natural gas from the Gulf of Mexico to the northeast (which is cheaper from overseas). With respect to nuclear, we here in Connecticut are living in a 1960s nuclear world. In the meantime, the rest of the world has witnessed and experienced incredible developments in mini nuclear power plants.
Our current regulations need to revised to facilitate the rapid and cost-effective construction of these plants. Instead, our government believes in windmills and solar power. Windmills have been problematic both from a technical and environmental standpoint and solar panels are mostly being produced in China. Neither one provides electricity on a consistent basis. Considering our adversarial relationship with China, it is foolish for us to be dependent upon them for solar panels and battery storage.
Unlike the US, France produces cost effective nuclear power that makes electric heat pumps less expensive than the burning of fossil fuels for heat. The only way this country can go "green" is if we have enough cheap green electricity. That is currently not a reality here in Connecticut even though fossil fuel prices for diesel, gas and natural gas are still very high.
**Tax Incentives**
The third area to combat the decline in manufacturing and commercial buildings is the lack of tax incentives. Given the work from home experience that many of us enjoyed, the modern employee has been successful at working from home for some period of time. This does not necessarily replace the Modern office, however, a hybrid work situation seems to becoming the norm for non-manufacturing industries.
Unlike independent contractors, W-2 employees are not able to deduct their home office under current tax guidelines. I would propose to embrace and incentivize the work from home lifestyle. Such incentives would also reduce some of the strain to our infrastructure by reducing some commuters off the roads. This freed-up capacity could be utilized by manufacturing, logistics and deliveries from a robust manufacturing boom without causing additional issues to our highways.
_As you can see, my campaign is focused at looking at federal assistance to local solutions in this federal state and local partnership. This is critical to transform Connecticut. We must retain our skilled workforce that comes out of our universities and trade schools with high paying and meaningful jobs that we would otherwise lose to other states when these graduates complete their university and or vocational training._
Now is the time for Connecticut to stop losing a vibrant workforce that could contribute to the Connecticut economy in meaningful ways and catapult us into a new economic boom. This revitalization would attract outside business to start looking at Connecticut again. It would also stop the hemorrhaging of the exodus of industry to states like Massachusetts, which was once compared to Connecticut as Taxachussets.
I am running for a host of issues, but this is one that I have witnessed over the past several years. I believe that we can bring federal dollars into Connecticut and make Connecticut an attractive place for new investment into our manufacturing and other sectors that utilize our commercial real estate assets, which are incredible in Fairfield county and throughout Connecticut.
**This is why I need you to get out and vote on the Republican Primary on August 13 with early voting starting August 5-11.**
_**I need your support to pass on these ideas to your friends and colleagues as we have a country to save. The only way we can do it is through the grassroots efforts of being inspired by solutions and passing them onto others and informing them of how candidates like me and others are out there.**_
I am looking out for your best interest and not the interests of Special interests. Please join us at [www.goldsteinforcongress.com](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4fb182db-f017-4bd6-9109-59cef3c418a2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

I believe that we can bring federal dollars into Connecticut and make Connecticut an attractive place for new investment into our manufacturing and other sectors that utilize our commercial real estate assets, which are incredible in Fairfield county and throughout Connecticut. This is why I need you to get out and vote on the Republican Primary on August 13 with early voting starting August 5-11. I need your support to pass on these ideas to your friends and colleagues as we have a country to save. The only way we can do it is through the grassroots efforts of being inspired by solutions and passing them onto others and informing them of how candidates like me and others are out there.** I am looking out for your best interest and not the interests of Special interests. ## Note from The Host Committee
---
| Welcome back to Host Committee Happenings. The Democratic National Convention is only **55** days away!
---
| | | | | | | | | | | The official application to volunteer at the 2024 Democratic National Convention is live! Thank you to the thousands of people who have already completed the application. If you are planning to volunteer but have not finished the application, be sure to visit [chicago2024.com/volunteer](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=ca9cb3d47a&e=e789b9d47e).
**Make sure to apply by July 1 to get the first pick of shifts!**
---
[APPLY NOW](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=bfd1c0c268&e=e789b9d47e)
| [](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=7ec744fc76&e=e789b9d47e)

|
---
|
## Follow the Host Committee on Social Media
---
| | | | | | | | | | | Counting down the days until August 19th? Make sure to stay updated on all the latest news from the 2024 convention by following us on social media. You can now follow us on Instagram, Facebook, Linkedin, and X.
---
| | | | | [](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=50c5d7a863&e=e789b9d47e)| [](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=91e8e4410f&e=e789b9d47e)| [](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=0ec578dd16&e=e789b9d47e)| [](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=0a430444bc&e=e789b9d47e)

## Attend a Volunteer Information Session
---
| Want to bring a friend with you to volunteer? Complete your application before July 1st to guarantee you get first pick of volunteer shifts. You also sign up for shifts together!
---
| | | | | | | | | | | If you have questions or want to learn more about volunteering, you can now register for our next volunteer information session. Details and registration links are below:
**Volunteer Information Session** Saturday, June 29, 2024 at 12 pm CDT
Sign up now!
---
[Register Here](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=0f79149c82&e=e789b9d47e)

## DNC Officially Moves Into United Center
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
| | On Monday, June 24th, we officially moved into the iconic United Center, home of the Chicago Bulls and Blackhawks! Owners Danny Writz and Micheal Reinsdorf presented a special key to our team to honor the momentous event.
We can’t wait to welcome delegates, visitors, and the Biden Administration to the [United Center](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=f4f0f5807e&e=e789b9d47e) in less than 55 days!
---
[Check Out ABC7’s Story](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=8024af993c&e=e789b9d47e)
|
---
|
## Volunteer Recruitment
---
| We loved stopping by the [Sundays on State](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=9ec9ede4b4&e=e789b9d47e) festival hosted by [Chicago Loop Alliance](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=edeeffcba0&e=e789b9d47e)! It was a blast to speak to community members and get them excited for the DNC. Amid the catchy music and vibrant street dancing, dozens of people signed up to be volunteers!
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
|
## LGBTQ+ Business Walk in Northalsted
---
| | | | | | | | | | | To celebrate Pride Month, last week, the Host Committee, local advocates, and elected officials toured LGBTQ+-owned businesses in **Lakeview** to highlight the diversity of Chicago’s small business community and uplift the contributions of LGBTQ+ Chicagoans. The group explored [Lark](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=8c3d22750e&e=e789b9d47e), [Sidetrack](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=4c59afb01f&e=e789b9d47e), and [Chicago Sugar Daddy](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=b72713cfeb&e=e789b9d47e) to learn about their impact on the community, and how their excitement for the DNC.
---

|
---
| Our team had so much fun at the [Juneteenth Festival](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=a81433f0e8&e=e789b9d47e) in **Homewood-Flossmoor**. It was great to celebrate Black culture and businesses in the area. We also had the opportunity to connect with community members while spreading the word about volunteer opportunities for the convention.
---
|
---
|
## Chicago Convention Trivia
---
| Thank you to all who responded to our trivia question last week. Congratulations to **Terry R.** who was the first to correctly respond!
**This week’s question:** How many times have the Democratic and Republican National Convention been held in the same year in Chicago?
---
|
---
|
## 77 Spotlight
---
| This week’s neighborhood spotlight focuses on three neighborhoods home to both historic sites and serving as a present-day cultural haven: Lakeview, Lincoln Square, and North Center.
Did you know **Lakeview** is home to the first officially recognized queer village in the United States? It’s home to one of the **largest LGBTQ+ communities in the Midwest!**
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
| 📷 _Sea Cow_
---
| | ⚾ Catch a game at historic [Wrigley Field](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=c6f9b691f7&e=e789b9d47e), home to Chicago’s northside baseball team, The Cubs! Built in 1914, this must-see attraction is the second-oldest baseball stadium in the country.
---
| 🍺 This pride month, celebrate with some delicious craft beer, smoked meat and more at [Good Times Brewery](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=b428ae942c&e=e789b9d47e).
🍕 Enjoy some delicious pizza at the late night restaurant [Big Gay Sal’s Pizza](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=e9f9816d80&e=e789b9d47e)
---
| Located on Chicago's Northside, **Lincoln Square** boasts a wide variety of independent shops, breweries, and a vibrant restaurant scene just minutes from Downtown.
---
| | | | | | | | | | | 🇩🇪 The DANK Haus German-American Cultural Center, showcases upcoming art exhibits, cooking classes, language classes, and neighborhood nights.
🍽 Check out Artango Bar and Steakhouse, an Argentine restaurant, serving up a variety of dishes, global wine, and Argentinian steak with live music!
---
|
---
| 📷 _Open House_
---
| **North Center** A vibrant neighborhood in Chicago’s northside, North Center features a wide range of businesses and activities including retailers, restaurants, live music, and theater.
🎭 Whether you are a fan of improv, drama, or experimental productions, North Center theaters has a production for everyone. [Bughouse Theater](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=144e382355&e=e789b9d47e) and [Strawdog Theatre](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=743ba728f7&e=e789b9d47e) are a couple of local favorites.
🍻 Cool down this summer with a beverage from Dovetail Brewery, a European style brewery that features Kolsch Service. Dovetail is also featured in the Host Committees [Venue Map](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=aeef8b5d18&e=e789b9d47e).
---
|
---
|
## Vendor Spotlights
---
| [Beyond Catering & Events](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=721bac2af5&e=e789b9d47e) has created unforgettable experiences for over 40 years, built on a foundation of family values, authenticity, dedication and a passion for food, hospitality, and community. Beyond Catering offers authentic made in Chicago brands with culinary expertise, creativity, has the ability to service groups of 10-20,000+ and is green caterer certified. Beyond Catering’s parent company boasts a portfolio of restaurants, The Original Rainbow Cone and home-made products that can be found in retailers nationwide.

## Staff Spotlight
---
| This week we are spotlighting our Deputy Director of Civic & Community Engagement, **J.D. Van Slyke**!
---
| | | | | | | | | | | If you are volunteering for the DNC, there is no doubt you know J.D. Charged with recruiting 12,000 volunteers, you will find J.D. at neighborhood events all around the city speaking with community members!
J.D. is originally from Garland, TX and currently resides in the **West Ridge** neighborhood of Chicago. He joined the Host Committee to take advantage of the once in a lifetime opportunity to showcase what makes his city special. When not talking to prospective volunteers, you can find J.D. enjoying a pastry at Sauce & Bread Kitchen and biking, sewing, or teaching his dog new tricks.

# Trump Trolling the Taliban
### "I sent a picture of his house to him"
| | | [Dan Carr](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
| Jun 25
---
| [](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
I hope this email finds you well.
I wanted to share with you a clip from one of my favorite interviews with President Donald Trump. In this interview, Trump trolls the Taliban in his style. His approach and confidence make this particular segment both memorable and entertaining. This is another reason why I love him.
If you haven't seen it yet, I highly recommend watching it. It's a fascinating glimpse into his persona and his handling of international affairs.
