| | Dear Friend, The War on Cops always picks up in election years -- and 2024 is no different. Police Officer Jeff Teng is being subjected to a malicious prosecution by a socialist prosecutor... **_...all because he confronted a mob that threatened to burn down his city and used NON-LETHAL projectiles to get the situation under control!_** You read that right – Jeff faces up to 99 years in prison -- for stopping rioters! It’s outrageous, but Jeff could suffer a horrendous miscarriage of justice if you and I don’t act now. Jeff is facing a trial soon -- this year, in fact. **[Can I count on your donation of $35 or more to help fund Jeff Teng’s critical but expensive defense?](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8jr1u4zAQBp9m1VEgl392weLuDBm4BOlTBfxZxQxES6boOH77QEaQdnfwzfiyTHm8O7B_AfGU0wqIIP8A4uX1Vur1ozwdmTo-_2cX81L09sV_gNjuC_2iPys9FZ-n7WoPXXJyTFx15IQVe6nR7EV3csLIkaThdrSehE9ipICJhx1yo7TGLjvkqLhBjUJbveuj4KgU92HvBZogQfGHp_eFao5erO3ma53n0se5dJM7tbasj7ABcFgpXiv1_kxpbhsBOJzjkgCHFFjDxKgwIxl9NZDDOl9rpLc4JwJ5SIFtKKNiZGCcY1ddWm55mvJqLCj-_gjZtJ8OvwMAAP__fbZjjA)** Once you hear all the facts of this case, I think you’ll agree that this prosecution shouldn’t be happening. Jeff’s journey on this nightmare started in May 2020, when hundreds of protestors gathered outside the Austin Police Department’s Eighth Street headquarters to protest the death of George Floyd. Jeff and dozens of other Austin Police Department officers stepped up to help control the crowd, to ensure it was peaceful, and to protect life, limb, and property... ... but the protesters’ energy began to swell, and they started throwing rocks, frozen water bottles, fireworks, and other dangerous objects at the police. The city was erupting. Buildings were damaged, vandalized, and looted. Vehicles belonging to the police department and innocent people were destroyed and set on fire. body:
| | | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87597929/481644970/-1989249276?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNhNzA0NTg0LTNlMzMtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=JVdaRVrMtBbys2A6tKA0QobyRyWXjJKEzEtnKbTm58o=&emci=f1f15547-1e30-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=ca704584-3e33-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230)Hi Peter, I don’t know about you, but summer is the perfect time to read! One of my favorite parts about summer is reading on the beach or in the afternoons near the river when I’m out camping. That’s why I’m excited to announce that OLCV will be hosting a summer book club. Together we’ll be reading an environmental themed book that was voted on, share ideas, and make friends! [**In order to join, you must fill out this sign-up form here, where you’ll be asked to vote on the book we read and our meeting date. **](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87597930/481644998/-1529894987?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNhNzA0NTg0LTNlMzMtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=JVdaRVrMtBbys2A6tKA0QobyRyWXjJKEzEtnKbTm58o=&emci=f1f15547-1e30-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=ca704584-3e33-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230) Our book club meeting will take place during the last week of August, between Monday August 26th to Thursday August 29th. The book will be announced after sign-ups close, but here’s the three nonfiction books we are choosing between:
1. **_The Intersectional Environmentalist_ by Leah Thomas:** envisions a world where the communities and voices most impacted by environmental injustice have the power, resources, and platforms to lead their communities into full liberation. (208 pages)

1. **_Emergent Strategy_ by adrienne maree brown:** explores radical self-help, society-help, and planet-help to shape the futures we want. (280 pages)

1. **_Becoming Kin: An Indigenous Call to Unforgetting the Past and Reimagining our Future_ by Patty Krawec:** visits Native and settler history, myth, identity, and spirituality helps us retrace our steps and pick up what was lost along the way: chances to honor rather than violate treaties, to see the land as a relative rather than a resource, and to unravel the history we have been taught. (240 pages)

**The deadline for sign-ups is on Friday, July 5th.[If you’re interested, please submit the sign-up form now!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87597931/481644999/-1529894987?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNhNzA0NTg0LTNlMzMtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=JVdaRVrMtBbys2A6tKA0QobyRyWXjJKEzEtnKbTm58o=&emci=f1f15547-1e30-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=ca704584-3e33-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230) **[For those joining our book club, please join our Facebook group here if you’d like to connect before our meeting in August.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87597932/481645000/-619261988?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNhNzA0NTg0LTNlMzMtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=JVdaRVrMtBbys2A6tKA0QobyRyWXjJKEzEtnKbTm58o=&emci=f1f15547-1e30-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=ca704584-3e33-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230) I’m looking forward to meeting some fellow readers and OLCV supporters this summer, and learn something together. See you in August! Sincerely,
Sarah Kline
OLCV Communications & Membership Coordinator |

I was born and raised in Akron, Ohio, and grew up on the city’s west side. Both of my parents served as elected leaders in Ohio, and I saw exactly what it was like to be an elected official. My mother was the first Black woman to serve on Akron City Council at-large. It’s because of them that I felt responsible for my community and decided to run for state representative. For eight years, I served as State Representative for Ohio House District 34. But one of my biggest challenges in office was being constantly told that I did not look like a legislator. And that’s because there had never been a Black woman under the age of 30 to be elected to the state legislature before me.

_**That’s why CO State Rep. Leslie Herod and I founded the Emerge Seated Together program—because so many Black women share the same experience of being told they don’t belong in elected office and challenged for wanting to serve their communities.**_

**The Emerge Seated Together program brings together Black women from across the country to give them not just the confidence but the tools they need to win.** It is an advanced leadership program designed for Black women elected and formerly elected officials who are ready to take the next step in advancing within their political journey – and it works.

Black women deserve a seat at the table in order to address their communities’ most urgent issues, including access to reproductive care. In Ohio, our communities voted overwhelmingly to pass Issue 1 in 2023, which enshrined abortion rights in our constitution. I need more Black Democratic women by my side to keep up the fight to protect and expand access to our most basic freedoms nationwide.

Emerge just announced Seated Together’s third cohort of trailblazing Black women preparing to run for higher office. But it takes significant resources, and that’s why we are turning to you for help.

_**With your support, we can recruit and train more Black women who seek to deepen their impact, run for office, and serve their communities.**_

Friend, I voted NO on the House of Representatives’ recently-passed military budget for 2025. name: Team Cornel West 2024
subject: Breaking News: Dr. Cornel West Secures Ballot Access in Vermont!
body:
The West-Abdullah 2024 Campaign is on the ballot in Vermont! Thanks for all the support!

| | | [ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=vermont_ballot_access&n=1)
---
---
Dear Peter, We are thrilled to announce a major victory for our campaign! Dr. Cornel West has officially secured ballot access in Vermont, marking a significant milestone in our journey toward justice and equality.
---
| [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/vermont_win?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=vermont_ballot_access&n=2 "READ THE PRESS RELEASE") [READ THE PRESS RELEASE](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/vermont_win?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=vermont_ballot_access&n=2)
---
**The Victory:** This achievement is a testament to the power of grassroots organizing and the unwavering support of people like you. Despite the challenges and obstacles put forth by the political establishment, we have shown that a movement powered by the people can overcome any hurdle. **Why This Matters:** Securing ballot access in Vermont is not just a logistical victory; it's a powerful statement against the entrenched systems that seek to maintain the status quo. As Dr. West stated, “This win is a clear message that the people’s voice will not be silenced. We are here to challenge the power structures and fight for a more just and equitable America.”
---
[ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/vermont_win?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=vermont_ballot_access&n=3)
---
**How You Can Help:**
* **Spread the Word:** Inform your friends, family, and community about the write-in campaign. Use social media, email, and word of mouth to make sure everyone knows how to write in Dr. Cornel West on their ballots.
* **Volunteer:** [Join our team](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/volunteer?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=vermont_ballot_access&n=4) to help educate voters on how to correctly write in Dr. West’s name. Every volunteer makes a difference in this grassroots movement.
* **Donate:** Your financial support is crucial. Donations help us fund educational campaigns, distribute materials, and organize volunteers to spread the message.

---
---
| [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=vermont_ballot_access&n=5 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=vermont_ballot_access&n=5)
---
**Get Started:** [Visit our website](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/vermont_win?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=vermont_ballot_access&n=6) to learn more about this victory and how you can continue to support our campaign. **Why Your Support Matters:** Dr. West's campaign is built on the foundations of economic justice, racial equality, environmental stewardship, and human rights. Unlike mainstream candidates, we are not beholden to corporate interests. This campaign is powered by the people, for the people.
---
---
## SPREAD THE WORD
---
---
We’ve included some social media posts and hashtags to help you spread the word:
* **Twitter:** "Victory in Vermont! Dr. Cornel West is officially on the ballot. Join us in the fight for justice and equality! #West2024 #JusticeForAll https://www.cornelwest2024.com/vermont_win"
* **Facebook:** "We did it! Dr. Cornel West has secured ballot access in Vermont. This is a huge step forward for our movement. Learn how you can support us and spread the word! #West2024 #Equality https://www.cornelwest2024.com/vermont_win"
* **Instagram:** "Exciting news! Dr. Cornel West is on the ballot in Vermont. Join the movement for justice and equality. #West2024 #ProgressiveChange https://www.cornelwest2024.com/vermont_win"

---
* * *
---
**Thank You:** We are beyond excited about the tremendous support we've received from Vermont! Your activism and dedication have brought us to this significant milestone. Together, we are making history and paving the way for transformative change across our country. Let’s continue this momentum and show that the people's voice will always prevail. **In eternal love and solidarity,**
The West-Abdullah 2024 Campaign Team
---
Cornel West for President · 8253A Backlick Rd., PO Box #1577, Newington, VA 22122, United States

Hey - my name is Byron Donalds.

As Co-Chair of one of the most important initiatives of the Republican Party, I wanted you to what we're doing right now to lay the groundwork for the biggest GOP landslide in AMERICAN HISTORY!

_**[A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen- so bear with me for a minute:](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=57fbebb296484123a467e9c1ed730187&_e=wlb8qVVuPl9lUI7n8O5rRPvrKwAfFQSmWV2GDkRmdKaYbcdx7MiZOIHDNZMfy8YnRPjdWh51FEWL0NxwKTpYpejrRptBECaje1JNJRfWGOpoXbBwdcXqYz7vt4CvSUmDSI_BsOBlfGEW9j0qErNIY4f8xpBTAl4vkmVdxjwG4MLRwjWyLLfIEGunYIPlP_BFa7yellaBzk8prpx8mNUPyZjAAkrB6wBXnwI91jqJaG6b5N01wDT-FHq90RpkvGXcb17DeSuRuYq2CmXBagbfxTYSvCPfzDJm7woEYFttJIDYicsdwwo4bCmnVDQ45ZIWtSHEbMZz6DLboartuBW29kvRv_TQngjF5NWHCZ6sEljLlha76UXKpuzstB-tYUkS9MKHoe5vFa9jBXxRgGa0ffRwT6CBmX6nlk__T3Tjn-Q%3D "A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen – so bear with me for a minute:")**_

-> If the Democrat Legal Machine tries any shenanigans, we'll be there to stop them
-> If Liberals can ballot harvest, we should ballot harvest even better
-> If they're sending poll watchers, we should send an army of our own
-> We're not pandering to minority voters, we're building relationships with them
-> We're expanding GOTV efforts to get young Conservatives to the ballot box
-> We're fighting bad election laws to make it easier to vote but harder to cheat

These are the nuts and bolts of winning campaigns up and down the ballot. And I'm proud to help lead these efforts.

As Conservatives, we have the issues on our side. We are the only commonsense Party. **If we get these campaign operations right, the Democrats are in serious trouble come election day.**

_But I have to be honest with you: building this level of infrastructure is very expensive._ We're running ads in costly swing-state markets, printing campaign literature, filling up gas tanks to knock doors, recruiting volunteers, and scaling up our voter contact programs.

And unlike the Democrats, we don't rely on Liberal billionaires and rich celebrities for funding.

body:
It’s important that we hear from you soon.

If you are unable to see the message below, [click here to view](https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTExNzkzNTgS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjAwMDQ1NzgzOQS2&mt=1&rt=0).
| | | |

| | |
## **MEMBERSHIP DRIVE 2024**
## **TRIPLE MATCH ACTIVE**
---
| | |
* * *
---
| | | | Peter — our Summer Membership Drive deadline is less than one week away, and it’s an important one. How many members pitch in to this annual fundraising drive determines how big our campaigns can go to defend our planet and our democracy for the rest of the year.
---
| | **This is a make-or-break year for the environment — which means** [**_your membership matters more than ever. And right now, your support will go 3x as far for people and our planet >>_**](https://links.messages.lcv.)
---
| | Your support powers our campaigns to:
* Secure and defend clean energy and climate progress
* Cut the air and water pollution that harms our communities’ health
* Strengthen and defend voting rights
* Protect public lands
_...and more!_

---
| | LCV is working on these issues every day. For example, over the next few weeks, Congress will vote on key proposals to fund the government — and anti-environment lawmakers are pursuing MASSIVE cuts to climate programs, clean energy investments, and environmental justice, among others.
---
| | And just last week, MAGA Republicans in Congress released legislation that would rob $13 _billion_ from climate, conservation, and clean energy programs — taking money out of the hands of farmers who want to improve our climate, soil, and environment and giving it to a few rich agribusinesses. Last but not least, they’re proposing _even more_ oil and gas drilling on public lands and working to overturn limits on harmful pollution.
---
| | **Peter, together, we** _**can**_**defeat MAGA Republicans’ attacks on our climate and protect the progress we’ve worked so hard to achieve. For that to happen, we need to mobilize — NOW.** LCV is mobilizing grassroots pressure on Congress as you’re reading this message. But at the end of the day, the impact our campaign can have will depend on members like you.
---
| | [**The best thing you can do right now is renew your LCV membership to power our hard-hitting environmental campaigns. Right now, all it takes is $5. And because this fight is so important,**_**every contribution is being TRIPLE MATCHED through the end of the month**_** >>**](https://links.messages.lcv.)
---
| | | [ RENEW MY MEMBERSHIP >> ](https://links.messages.lcv.)
---
| | LCV’s expert lobbying team is on Capitol Hill every day talking to members of Congress and their staffs. Our organizers are flooding offices with calls, filling inboxes with messages, and attending grassroots events to demand action on climate. We are the number one environmental organization putting pressure on leaders to make sure anti-environment forces in Congress can never enact their dangerous agenda into law.
---
| | But the truth is, a fight like this is expensive — and with all the attacks on the environment happening in Congress right now, our resources are running low. What we need most of all is your support.
---
| | **To keep our work going strong, we need to raise $40,000 before the end of the month. If everyone reading this right now were to pitch in just $5, we’d blow through that goal in minutes.** _Here’s where things stand:_
---
| |
## **OFFICIAL 2024 LEAGUE OF CONSERVATION VOTERS SUPPORTER RECORD**
**Name:** Peter Willis**2024 Member Status:** _**PENDING —**_[** _Renew your membership today for just $5 >>_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/dmyWFAGP8-)**Deadline:** 11:59 pm, June 30, 2024
---
| |
---
| | [**_Remember — a donor is offering a triple match, so your contribution goes even further than usual if you give today. Please, renew your membership for just $5 right now >>_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/mkyVH26-)
---
| | Thanks for standing with our movement, Peter. I’m forever grateful to have you in our corner.
---

President
League of Conservation Voters

Climate crisis: We can’t take chances when it comes to preserving our planet. The Supreme Court: We’ve already seen the far-right court overturn Roe and overrule student debt relief. Democrats need Senate control to have a say in future nominations. As Co-Chair of one of the most important initiatives of the Republican Party, I wanted you to what we're doing right now to lay the groundwork for the biggest GOP landslide in AMERICAN HISTORY!

_**[A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen- so bear with me for a minute:](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=774d72d204dd476faff04c4accc0faca&_e=gDQj0Xa7LLAyXSvEfZgm5jm7jeSsSOhQCSylWbGscgHaPHn4d_kK1ddxMN72GGYoE_YBP7phijc6KCr9zYnbWhRxr_hCpoE8_z5691WpjC_RHWuJEpsgbgxm5Ykyg4dDUGonNEy6LW889XromNCrrH6i2YLE_QOyLOzLnU_44y67eeXZSN5zja2JTEYLSCAqyNBbyOe46VlcZLalFGxLuNedYQalaRRbRTfDpghcTe4A_ox4IsxhLaMQNOUrDYL7jMnM1rumllTmvES7leyY9jKNxmcS5RdbwozhZ1cWJSvuuvZeVurEGGpnGGMUtx9d95vl17kIO1h-CF3CLUqpgMYAioBgfE08vxqOnIKw5d7patEBaRrJ9y46D1xPxDc57dGIlQ06vUWqyzSEpKCrab_JZGDkzRZAd617o-CXLnw%3D "A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen – so bear with me for a minute:")**_

-> If the Democrat Legal Machine tries any shenanigans, we'll be there to stop them
-> If Liberals can ballot harvest, we should ballot harvest even better

-> We're not pandering to minority voters, we're building relationships with them
-> We're expanding GOTV efforts to get young Conservatives to the ballot box
-> We're fighting bad election laws to make it easier to vote but harder to cheat

As Conservatives, we have the issues on our side. We are the only commonsense Party. **If we get these campaign operations right, the Democrats are in serious trouble come election day.**

_But I have to be honest with you: building this level of infrastructure is very expensive._ We're running ads in costly swing-state markets, printing campaign literature, filling up gas tanks to knock doors, recruiting volunteers, and scaling up our voter contact programs.

And unlike the Democrats, we don't rely on Liberal billionaires and rich celebrities for funding.

I'm perfectly okay with that. But it means if we want to WIN BIG, the burden falls on all of us to step up. _**[That's why I'm coming to you now - would you be willing to pitch in a few bucks to help kick start these efforts? Whether it's 10 bucks or 100 bucks, I only ask that everyone pitches in SOMETHING.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=774d72d204dd476faff04c4accc0faca&_e=gDQj0Xa7LLAyXSvEfZgm5jm7jeSsSOhQCSylWbGscgHaPHn4d_kK1ddxMN72GGYoE_YBP7phijc6KCr9zYnbWhRxr_hCpoE8_z5691WpjC_RHWuJEpsgbgxm5Ykyg4dDUGonNEy6LW889XromNCrrH6i2YLE_QOyLOzLnU_44y67eeXZSN5zja2JTEYLSCAqyNBbyOe46VlcZLalFGxLuNedYQalaRRbRTfDpghcTe4A_ox4IsxhLaMQNOUrDYL7jMnM1rumllTmvES7leyY9hUGzZNFPn5TaJNdkleZaXJ2lnDxCTdlRCbxllL6KTL7oAs9_guYH_WKSw6cgCloJTyN_Ow2vcuMvDifN5Grogc29oYHRe_yIB72maS9IEueYz0FEWRRTwe6jMrD8cvmFl0RIwGcv9CD9uyPVivi1A8%3D "That’s why I’m coming to you now – would you be willing to pitch in a few bucks to help kick start these efforts? | I got a few free minutes here. No calls, no meetings. It isn’t much, but...
Derek, I have a few free minutes here. No calls, no meetings. I know that doesn’t sound like much, but with a newborn at home, chaos in Congress, and a campaign to run... trust me, it’s a gift.
And I know we send a lot of emails, but I wanted to take a few of those minutes to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you.
The truth is, when I jumped into this race I had no idea how things were going to go. I didn’t know if this was going to be a two-way race, a three-way race, a thirty-way race. We had no clue what things would look like at this point.
But things have changed. This race is locked in now, and Kari Lake is my opponent — someone way more interested in burning our democracy down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about unity, or reaching across the aisle. She is in this for herself, and for Trump.
And if she wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for Arizona and the country. She’s dangerous. Really.
**She’s also been raising a ton of money lately, and that’s extremely concerning. There’s a real chance that she takes this Senate seat. The polls are incredibly close, and the pundits all say this is one of the most likely states in the country to flip.**
One of the biggest FEC deadlines of the entire campaign is right around the corner, and when it hits we’re going to be legally required to release our fundraising numbers.
If we’re going to defeat Kari Lake, hold on to the Senate, and defeat Donald Trump, I’m going to need a ton of support from people like you. We need to show a lot of our strength in this FEC report.
So, please:
**[Can you make a $10 contribution to my campaign and to Adam Schiff today? The amount really isn’t as important as the number of donations we receive. clean_body: | I got a few free minutes here. No calls, no meetings. It isn’t much, but... Derek, I have a few free minutes here. No calls, no meetings. I know that doesn’t sound like much, but with a newborn at home, chaos in Congress, and a campaign to run... trust me, it’s a gift. And I know we send a lot of emails, but I wanted to take a few of those minutes to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you. The truth is, when I jumped into this race I had no idea how things were going to go. I didn’t know if this was going to be a two-way race, a three-way race, a thirty-way race. We had no clue what things would look like at this point. But things have changed. This race is locked in now, and Kari Lake is my opponent — someone way more interested in burning our democracy down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about unity, or reaching across the aisle. She is in this for herself, and for Trump. And if she wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for Arizona and the country. She’s dangerous. Really. She’s also been raising a ton of money lately, and that’s extremely concerning. There’s a real chance that she takes this Senate seat. The polls are incredibly close, and the pundits all say this is one of the most likely states in the country to flip. One of the biggest FEC deadlines of the entire campaign is right around the corner, and when it hits we’re going to be legally required to release our fundraising numbers. If we’re going to defeat Kari Lake, hold on to the Senate, and defeat Donald Trump, I’m going to need a ton of support from people like you. We need to show a lot of our strength in this FEC report.
